json.title: Full Stack Tech Lead (Frappe/Python)
json.companyName: International Committee of the Red Cross - ICRC
json.descriptionHtml:
About The ICRC

Since 1863, the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) has worked to relieve suffering and preserve human dignity during war and armed violence. Alongside our Red Cross and Red Crescent partners, we deliver life-saving aid across front lines and strive to reconnect families and locate missing people.

Engaging with authorities and armed forces on all sides, often confidentially, we advocate for humane treatment of detainees and urge compliance with international humanitarian law to protect civilians from harm, including online.

Purpose of the Role

The Full Stack Tech Lead (Frappe/Python) will design, develop, and maintain the new Protection Digital ecosystem, built on the Frappe Framework as its core technology, replacing the existing on-premise Microsoft Dynamics CRM solution. The role spans backend and frontend development as well as integration with other systems, with priorities set in collaboration with the product owner and solution architects.

Main Duties & Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain the new Protection Digital ecosystem using the Frappe Framework.
  • Build REST APIs and integrate external systems and services.
  • Design and optimize MariaDB database structures and queries.
  • Develop responsive frontend interfaces using JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and Frappe UI tools.
  • Create custom DocTypes, reports, workflows, scripts, and dashboards.
  • Write server-side business logic in Python.
  • Implement role-based permissions and security best practices.
  • Troubleshoot bugs, performance issues, and production incidents.
  • Manage containerized deployments using Docker and Kubernetes/OpenShift.
  • Create and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps and GitHub for automated build, testing, and deployment.
  • Monitor application performance, uptime, logs, and infrastructure health.
  • Perform code reviews and maintain technical documentation.
  • Collaborate with the product owner, business experts, ICRC architects, other members of the agile delivery team, and open-source communities.
  • Ensure all deployed applications operate properly and follow operational procedures.
  • Anticipate technical and operational needs; identify and solve problems.
  • Contribute to solution design, provide support and documentation, and train support teams on their use as needed.
  • Resolve assigned incidents and requests, ensuring resolution times meet service and operational level agreements (SLAs and OLAs).
  • Proactively manage and follow up on tickets, and contribute to monitoring all product tickets, requests, and backlog.
  • Support ICT teams in the field in the use of global and centrally managed ICT solutions.
  • Work to continuously improve ICRC's ICT services and operations.


Professional & Education Background

  • IT engineering degree or equivalent.
  • ITIL and DevOps certification is an asset.
  • Technical certification or equivalent professional experience.
  • Excellent command of English (spoken and written); fluency in French is an advantage.
  • 5+ years of production experience in Frappe development using Python, with a demonstrable open-source presence.
  • 5+ years of frontend development experience, including 3+ years working with Frappe UI (Vue) in production.
  • Experience integrating and running technical solutions.
  • Experience with development and operations (DevOps) processes.
  • Experience with technical support processes.


Key Competencies

  • Deep mastery of DocType metadata, workflows, permission hooks, the custom report builder, RQ background jobs, and scheduled events.
  • Strong command of REST API design on Frappe, including OIDC client-credentials flows.
  • Deep expertise in PWAs, Service Workers, and Background Sync, including client-side persistence patterns, conflict resolution UI, and offline UX.
  • Proficiency with RTL layouts and internationalization (i18n).
  • Strong discipline in unit and integration testing (Frappe test runner, pytest).
  • Proficiency with Git version control.
  • Contribution to the Frappe UI ecosystem is a strong plus.


Additional Information

  • Location: Geneva
  • Type of contract: Open-ended
  • Activity rate: 100%
  • Start date: October/November 2026
  • Recruiter: Alejandra Rodriguez
  • Application deadline: Tuesday, 21st of July 2026


Important information: For future employees and their dependents who are not EU and/or EFTA nationals, settling in Switzerland is now required. Direct settlement in France upon arrival is no longer possible.

Our Values

At the ICRC, we value impact, collaboration, respect, and compassion. We seek candidates who demonstrate behaviors based on these shared values. For more information on the ICRC values, please visit this page.

json.title: Senior Technical Support Engineer, Observe by Snowflake
json.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Observe by Snowflake is an AI-powered observability platform built on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud and engineered for scale. We ingest and store logs, metrics, traces, and events on an open, scalable data lakehouse, using open formats like Apache Iceberg, at dramatically lower cost. A dynamic Context Graph and chat-based AI SRE provide rich context and automated workflows so teams can move from detection to root cause of production issue and resolution 10x faster.

Leading engineering teams at companies like Capital One, Topgolf, and Dialpad rely on Observe to troubleshoot hundreds of terabytes of telemetry daily while maintaining reliability at enterprise scale. As part of Snowflake, Observe combines startup-style ownership and velocity with the global reach, operational excellence, and ecosystem of one of the world’s leading data platforms.

As a Senior Technical Support Engineer, you will be a trusted advisor and technical resource for our customers in the EMEA region. This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives in dynamic environments, loves troubleshooting complex technical issues, and is passionate about delivering exceptional support experiences.

You’ll be responsible for resolving high-impact technical issues, driving customer success, and collaborating closely with product, engineering, and customer success teams. This is an opportunity to shape how support is delivered and to contribute to the evolution of our platform and processes.

Responsibilities

  • Deliver expert-level technical support to customers through phone, email, and chat.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues involving our observability platform, integrations, and customer environments.
  • Partner with engineering teams responsible for performance to become the subject matter expert on performance issues related to components like dashboards, monitors, and datasets. Lead initiatives to improve performance and educate engineering, technical support, and sales engineering teams on best practices.
  • Help to design and build AI skills that increase technical support engineering productivity, quality and speed.
  • Own and manage high-priority escalations, coordinating with engineering and product teams to drive resolution.
  • Create and maintain high-quality technical documentation, including knowledge base articles and runbooks.
  • Act as a technical liaison between customers and internal teams, translating customer feedback into actionable product insights.
  • Participate in the on-call rotation to support urgent customer issues outside normal hours.
  • Proactively contribute to process improvement, tooling, and support automation initiatives.
  • Mentor junior support engineers and help level up the broader team through knowledge sharing.


Qualifications

  • Technical Expertise
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field.
  • 5+ years in a technical support or customer-facing engineering role, ideally in a SaaS, DevOps, or observability-focused environment.
  • Deep familiarity with operating systems (Linux, Unix, macOS, and Windows) and modern networking concepts.
  • Proficient in scripting languages such as Python or Bash.
  • Experience with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes; particularly in troubleshooting, scaling, and deployment contexts.
  • Strong diagnostic and debugging skills across complex distributed systems.


Soft Skills

  • Exceptional problem-solving skills and a methodical, customer-first approach to issue resolution.
  • Clear, concise communicator able to translate complex technical topics for non-technical audiences.
  • Calm under pressure, with the ability to multitask and prioritize in high-stakes situations.
  • Collaborative mindset, with a track record of building strong working relationships across functions.
  • Demonstrated leadership potential, including the ability and drive to lead a team, mentor colleagues, and autonomously manage initiatives.


Bonus Points

  • Experience with observability/monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Jaeger, Loki, or similar platforms.
  • Proficiency with OpenTelemetry (OTEL), configuring and troubleshooting for distributed tracing, metrics, and logging.
  • Experience using Terraform to deploy infrastructure preferably in combination with CI/CD tools such as Github Actions or Jenkins.
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes clusters, including Helm, CNI, CSI, kubectl, and k9s.
  • Exposure to modern data storage and retrieval systems including SQL, NoSQL, and data warehousing technologies.


Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

json.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer – Palantir Foundry / Databricks
json.descriptionHtml:
About 10x Partners

We are a high-impact consultancy specialising in Palantir Foundry and AIP. Founded by ex-Palantir engineers and elite consultants, we deliver rapid, high-value solutions to our clients through deep technical expertise and real business impact.


Our mission

Solve the world's biggest challenges with the best data & AI operating system: Foundry & AIP.


The role

We are hiring a driven and ambitious Senior Engineer with deep experience in Palantir Foundry / Databricks to lead delivery for strategic client projects.

As one of our first hires, you’ll work directly with founders and take ownership of high-impact projects, you will:

  • Build end-to-end workflows from data integration to decision tools using Foundry
  • Work directly with client stakeholders of all levels (CxOs, product leads, data teams) to uncover opportunities and deliver business value
  • Lead engineering teams on high visibility projects, from beginning to end
  • Shape our engineering culture, delivery model, and future product direction


You bring

  • Strong software engineering background (e.g., Python, Spark, TypeScript)
  • Deep understanding of data modelling, ontologies, and operational workflows
  • Ability to lead engineering teams in complex client environments
  • Consulting mindset: able to speak business and tech with various types of stakeholders
  • Startup energy: proactive, independent, high-output with attention to quality
  • End-to-end experience with Palantir Foundry / AIP / Databricks


Broad exposure matters more than years: two years across many use cases (from Data Connection to Ontology-aware apps) beats five years doing only data pipelines at one place.

You can work independently with clients, without close supervision.

We’re looking for people with a founder mindset, proactive, fast, and fully accountable.


Location

This is a remote-first role with optional team gatherings in Switzerland and client sites.


Why join 10x Partners?

  • Elite team: Work with ex-Palantir and top Foundry experts
  • Serious impact: Lead engagements from day one and directly contribute to company development
  • High-growth: Together we will build something rare: a boutique, technical and high-impact consultancy
  • True ownership: Take end-to-end responsibility for strategic client outcomes and internal initiatives
  • High agency, low politics: Lean team, zero red tape. Your ideas shape client delivery, internal tooling, and company strategy
  • Flexible setup: Remote-first with options to travel, collaborate onsite with clients, and join team off-sites in Switzerland
  • Premium compensation: 110 - 140k CHF

It offers a unique opportunity for a senior professional to integrate quantitative modeling, computational science, and software engineering into practical, high-impact solutions. Send us your application

Apply now

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust, high-performance systems supporting quantitative analytics and optimization, trading workflows, and risk management
  • Implement and optimize models for pricing, asset optimization, and risk calculations, with emphasis on performance and reliability
  • Handle real-time market and operational data streams to feed analytics and decision-making systems
  • Collaborate closely with Trading, Structuring, Risk, and Quant teams to deliver production-ready, practical solutions
  • Follow up on projects from conception through implementation and continuous improvement
  • Ensure operational reliability, monitoring, CI/CD, and maintainability of critical systems and infrastructure, collaborating closely with IT
  • Contribute to engineering best practices, mentor team members, and support continuous improvement

  • Extensive software engineering experience across backend, frontend, databases, APIs, and infrastructure

  • Strong system design skills with focus on reliability, maintainability, and performance
  • Good communication skills and ability to collaborate across front-office and cross-functional teams
  • Fluent English, additional languages a plus

Competitive salary package

Market-oriented salary

Training and development

Diverse opportunities for career growth

federica.maraschio@alpiq.com

Cookie settings

At Alpiq, we are committed to creating an inclusive work environment, where everyone can bring their ‘whole selves’ to work and feel valued, respected, and heard. This principle is central to our company’s purpose, values, and leadership approach. We strongly believe that organizations thrive through the inclusion of diversity. Everyone’s energy matters regardless of characteristics, such as age, gender, nationality, language, sexual orientation and identity, religion, social or ethnic background or any other personal traits.

At Alpiq, data privacy is an important topic. Please therefore take note of the corresponding Privacy Notice that appears in the online application form and explains in detail the purpose for which we process your personal data. It is of great concern to us to inform you as transparently as possible and process your data only in a fair manner.

json.title: Process Data Engineer & Scrum Master
json.descriptionHtml:
Wer dieselben Werte lebt, kann echte Veränderung vorantreiben – für eine Zukunft, in der wir gemeinsam den Schweizer Finanzplatz prägen. Wir setzen auf Vertrauen, Wertschätzung und ein Miteinander auf Augenhöhe – in einem modernen, flexiblen Arbeitsumfeld am Puls der Zeit.

Process Data Engineer & Scrum Master

 Du willst dich entfalten? Wir geben dir den Raum dazu.

Gestalte mit uns einfache, kundenzentrierte Prozesse. Im Delivery Team Process Mining arbeiten wir mit den Prozessdaten der PostFinance – von Analyse über Aufbereitung bis zur Visualisierung.

Als Process Data Engineer schaffst du Transparenz in komplexen Kundenprozessen, beantwortest zentrale Business-Fragen und kommunizierst deine Erkenntnisse zielgruppengerecht.

Zusätzlich übernimmst du als Delivery Team Lead Verantwortung für die Weiterentwicklung des Teams – gemeinsam mit Product Owner und Architecture Owner.

Werde Teil eines innovativen Teams in einer führenden Schweizer Bank!

Jetzt bewerben

Pensum

80-100%

Arbeitsort

Bern / Homeoffice

Anstellungsdauer

unbefristet

Lohnrange

CHF 110’000 bis CHF 130’000 pro Jahr bei 100%-Pensum

Das kannst du bewirken

  • Du entwickelst in einem agilen Delivery Team neue Datenlösungen rund um Prozessdaten und bringst bestehende Lösungen gezielt weiter
  • Du übersetzt dank deiner starken Abstraktions- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit komplexe Business-Fragen in wirkungsvolle Datenlösungen und vermittelst diese verständlich
  • Du erweiterst kontinuierlich dein Know-how, vernetzt dich aktiv und teilst deine Erfahrungen im und über das Team hinaus
  • Du stellst als Delivery Team Lead (ca. 40%) die Lieferfähigkeit des Teams sicher, förderst die agile Arbeitsweise und schaffst optimale Rahmenbedingungen für eine produktive Zusammenarbeit

Das bringst du mit

  • Höhere Aus- oder Weiterbildung (FH/Uni) in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Fundierte Erfahrung in der Datenanalyse, im Data Engineering und in der Datenmodellierung - sowohl mit Data Lake Technologien (Kafka, Spark, Iceberg etc.) als auch mit relationalen Technologien (Oracle); idealerweise ergänzt mit Kenntnissen im Software Engineering (z. B. mit Java)
  • Erfahrung in agilen Arbeitsweisen (Scrum), idealerweise in einer Rolle als Delivery Team Lead oder Scrum Master
  • Interesse an Prozessoptimierung sowie an der Visualisierung von Prozessen und Daten und Freude an der Arbeit mit fachlichen Fragestellungen (Requirements Engineering)
  • Offene, kommunikative Persönlichkeit mit Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Teamgeist
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, sowie gute Englischkenntnisse

Lohngleichheit

Offenheit und Transparenz gehören zu unserer Kultur – auch beim Lohn. Deshalb geben wir bei Stelleninseraten die Lohnrange an. Damit setzen wir ein klares Zeichen für Lohngleichheit: Gleichwertige Arbeit wird bei uns im gleichen Rahmen entlöhnt und gemäss der Lohnsystematik von PostFinance fair festgelegt.

Für diese Stelle liegt der Jahreslohn bei einem 100%-Pensum zwischen CHF 110’000 und CHF 130’000. Der konkrete Lohn richtet sich nach deinem Profil und deiner Erfahrung und kann je nach Ausprägung leicht unter oder über dieser Bandbreite liegen.

Darum startest du mit uns

Zeit für Erholung

6 Wochen Ferien und die Möglichkeit auf unbezahlten Urlaub.

Flexible Arbeitsmodelle

Teilzeit, Job- und Topsharing.

Individuelle Entwicklung

Vielfältige Aus- und Weiterbildungsangebote, temporäre Stellenwechsel und Stages.

Moderne Arbeitswelten

Moderne Arbeitsplätze, Co-Working in Bern und Zürich sowie Homeoffice in vielen Bereichen.

Mutter- & Vaterschaftsurlaub

18 Wochen voll bezahlter Mutterschafts- und 4 Wochen Vaterschaftsurlaub.

Gesundheit im Fokus

Präventive Angebote, ergonomische Arbeitsplätze und gezielte Unterstützung bei längeren Ausfällen.

Mobilitätsangebote

Gratis Halbtax oder vergünstigtes GA sowie attraktive Velo-, Carsharing- und E-Auto-Angebote.

Gelebte Chancengerechtigkeit

Unter anderem durch transparente Lohnangaben in unseren Stelleninseraten.

Hast du noch Fragen?

Fragen zur Stelle?

Markus Gneupel

Solution Team Lead Analytics

json.title: DevOps Platform Engineer
json.descriptionHtml:
Ivy Partners est une société de conseil suisse qui accompagne les entreprises dans leurs défis stratégiques, technologiques et organisationnels.


Nous avons à cœur d’offrir à nos collaborateurs une carrière qui favorise leur épanouissement personnel et professionnel. Nous les accompagnons dans leur montée en compétences et leur ouvrons de réelles perspectives d’évolution.


En tant que DevOps - spécialisé IAM chez Ivy Partners, vous serez amené(e) à :

• Concevoir, déployer et maintenir des plateformes et solutions IAM (Identity Access Management) dans des environnements cloud et hybrides.

• Automatiser les processus d'intégration, de déploiement et de gestion des identités et des accès en utilisant des outils DevOps.

• Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes de sécurité, d'infrastructure et de développement pour garantir la conformité des accès et la sécurité.

• Contribuer à la définition et à la mise en œuvre de politiques de sécurité, d'audit et de gestion des accès.

• Surveiller, diagnostiquer et résoudre les incidents et problèmes liés à IAM.

• Rester à jour avec les dernières tendances et avancées technologiques en matière d'IAM et de DevOps.


Vous êtes notre candidat(e) idéal(e) si :

• Vous avez une expérience significative en ingénierie DevOps avec une compréhension approfondie de Kubernetes et de l'orchestration de conteneurs.

• Vous maîtrisez les pratiques de craftsmanship logiciel, la programmation et la conception d'API (Python, Java, Go, Bash ou équivalent).

• Vous avez de l'expérience avec les systèmes cloud tels que AWS et la configuration infrastructure-as-code.

• Vous êtes capable de réaliser du debug inter-fonctionnel à travers les couches applicatives et infrastructure.

• Vous avez une compréhension complète de l'architecture système et des composants de plateforme.

• Vous avez un esprit d'équipe, vous êtes autonome, rigoureux(se) et apte à travailler dans un environnement agile.

• Vous maîtrisez le français et l'anglais (écrit et parlé).


Pourquoi rejoindre Ivy Partners ?


Bienveillance | Soucieux de nos employés, nous leur garantissons un environnement favorable où chacun est valorisé et soutenu avec des formations et de réelles perspectives d’évolution.

Confiance | Nous avons à cœur de bâtir des relations solides et durables avec nos clients. Travailler avec nous, c’est développer un partenariat fondé sur la confiance, le professionnalisme et la transparence à chaque instant.

Innovation | Nous allions technologie et créativité pour mener à bien des transformations numériques à fort impact.

Responsabilité | La collectivité est à la base de tout ce que nous entreprenons, et nous prenons cette responsabilité au sérieux en mettant tout en œuvre pour avoir un impact positif.

json.title: System Engineer / DevOps (OpenShift / Kubernetes)
json.descriptionHtml:
Unternehmen im Überblick

Die Fincons Group ist ein IT-Beratungsunternehmen, welches seit 40 Jahren die digitale Zukunft führender Unternehmen auf internationalen Märkten gestaltet. Die Fincons Group hat sich einen Namen gemacht, indem sie neue Geschäftsmodelle und die rasche Entwicklung von IT-Systemen vorhersieht und erfolgreich interpretiert. Dazu hat sie ein komplettes Dienstleistungsangebot aufgebaut: von der Forschung und Beratung bis hin zu Design und Entwicklung, von der Systemintegration führender Softwarelösungen bis hin zum Anwendungsmanagement, wobei sie ihre Kunden Schritt für Schritt auf ihrem Weg der digitalen Transformation unterstützt. Fincons ist ein multinationales Unternehmen mit mehr als 2.600 Mitarbeitern und mehreren Niederlassungen weltweit (in Italien, der Schweiz, Deutschland, Frankreich, dem Vereinigten Königreich, Belgien und den USA), aber vor allem ein Familienunternehmen, in dem die Gründer mit Engagement und Leidenschaft eine strategische Rolle spielen und das Unternehmen auf den gleichen Prinzipien einer vereinten und fürsorglichen Familie gründen.

Aufgaben:

  • Sicherstellung des Betriebs sowie des Lifecycle-Managements und der Weiterentwicklung der OpenShift- und Kubernetes-Plattformen (On-Premises und Cloud)
  • Analyse, Optimierung und proaktives Performance-Tuning der bestehenden Umgebungen
  • Entgegennahme, Analyse und nachhaltige Behebung von Störungen im Rahmen des Incident- und Problemmanagements
  • Planung, Koordination und Umsetzung von Changes gemäss definierten Changemanagement-Prozessen
  • Effiziente Bearbeitung von Jira-Tickets gemäss Priorisierung und Zuweisung durch den Product Owner
  • Aktive Teilnahme an agilen Zeremonien im Team sowie im ART (z. B. Sprints und PI Planning)


Anforderungen:

  • Fundierte Erfahrung mit Red Hat OpenShift und Kubernetes (On-Premises)
  • Kenntnisse in Oracle Forms, ADF und WebLogic Server (WLS)
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Linux (RHEL)
  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit Ansible
  • Solide Grundkenntnisse in den Bereichen Netzwerk, Security, Storage und Betriebssysteme
  • Praxiserfahrung mit Splunk und ServiceNow
  • Kenntnisse agiler Arbeitsmethoden (SAFe, Scrum)
  • Gute Kenntnisse von ITIL-Prozessen
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
  • Strukturierte, selbstständige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise
  • Erfahrung in einem agilen, teamorientierten Arbeitsumfeld


Warum Fincons?

  • Innovation & Vielfalt: Arbeite an zukunftsweisenden Technologien in einem kreativen Umfeld.
  • Karriere & Weiterentwicklung: Profitiere von individuellen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.
  • Eine Unternehmenskultur, in der unsere hochqualifizierten und zufriedenen Mitarbeiter der Motor unseres Erfolgs sind.
  • Flexibilität: Hybrides Arbeiten mit Home-Office-Option.


Bewirb dich jetzt!

Alle qualifizierten Bewerber werden ohne Rücksicht auf Rasse, Hautfarbe, Religion, Geschlecht, sexuelle Orientierung, Geschlechtsidentität, nationale Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung oder geschützten Veteranenstatus oder eine andere gesetzlich geschützte Grundlage in Übereinstimmung mit dem geltenden Recht für eine Beschäftigung in Betracht gezogen.

Die Daten werden ausschließlich zum Zwecke dieser oder zukünftiger Auswahl verarbeitet und gespeichert, wodurch die in Art. 1 genannten Rechte garantiert werden. 13 Gesetzesdekret 196/03 und EU-Verordnung 679/2016 (DSGVO)

json.title: Senior Data Engineer - Ag & Trading, EMEA M/F/D
json.descriptionHtml:
Cargill is committed to providing food and agricultural solutions to nourish the world in a safe, responsible, and sustainable way. Sitting at the heart of the supply chain, we partner with farmers and customers to source, make and deliver products that are vital for living.

Our 155,000 team members innovate with purpose, providing customers with life’s essentials so businesses can grow, communities prosper, and consumers live well. With over 160 years of experience as a family company, we look ahead while remaining true to our values. We put people first. We reach higher. We do the right thing—today and for generations to come.

Job Purpose and Impact

The Senior Data Engineer - Agriculture&Trading specialist designs, builds and maintains complex data systems that enable data analysis and reporting. With minimal supervision, this job ensures that large sets of data are efficiently processed and made accessible for decision making.

Key Accountabilities

  • DATA INFRASTRUCTURE: Prepares data infrastructure to support the efficient storage and retrieval of data.
  • DATA FORMATS: Examines and resolves appropriate data formats to improve data usability and accessibility across the organization.
  • DATA & ANALYTICAL SOLUTIONS: Develops complex data products and solutions using advanced engineering and cloud based technologies, ensuring they are designed and built to be scalable, sustainable and robust.
  • DATA PIPELINES: Develops and maintains streaming and batch data pipelines that facilitate the seamless ingestion of data from various data sources, transform the data into information and move to data stores like data lake, data warehouse and others.
  • DATA SYSTEMS: Reviews existing data systems and architectures to identify areas for improvement and optimization.
  • STAKEHOLDER MANAGEMENT: Collaborates with multi-functional data and advanced analytic teams as well as with business teams to gain requirements and ensure that data solutions meet the functional and non-functional needs of various partners.
  • DATA FRAMEWORKS: Builds complex prototypes to test new concepts and implements data engineering frameworks and architectures that improve data processing capabilities and support advanced analytics initiatives.
  • AUTOMATED DEPLOYMENT PIPELINES: Develops automated deployment pipelines improving efficiency of code deployments with fit for purpose governance.
  • DATA MODELING: Performs complex data modeling aligned to datastore technologies to ensure sustainable performance, accessibility, and effective consumption by BI, analytics, and downstream systems.

Qualifications

json.title: Consultant DevOps Python/Azure
json.descriptionHtml:
Société d’ingénierie informatique et de services du numérique créée en 2004, Qim info est implantée en Suisse 🇨🇭 (Genève, Lausanne, Zurich & Bâle) et en France 🇫🇷 (Annecy, Lyon & Paris). Appartenant au groupe MoOngy, l’entreprise bénéficie aussi d’un réseau de développement international 🌐.


3e entreprise informatique de Suisse romande (ICT Journal), Qim info c’est surtout un ensemble de consultant.e.s capables d’intervenir à tous les niveaux d’un système d’information sur différents métiers (Études & Développement 💻, Fonctionnel 🔧, Infrastructures & Réseaux 🌐, Data 📊, DevOps 🚀...) et différents secteurs d’activités (Banque 🏦, Finance 💰, Assurance 📜, Luxe ✨, Retail 🛍️, Aéronautique ✈️...).


Avec plus de 650 collaborateurs, nous sommes toujours à la recherche de nouveaux talents ! 🌟


En quelques mots 🎯

Nous recrutons actuellement un(e) Consultant(e) DevOps Python/Azure pour accompagner les équipes de notre client grand compte.


Missions :

  • Accompagner la mise en place de la gouvernance DevOps
  • Définir et déployer des standards de développement
  • Mettre en place et améliorer les processus de CI/CD
  • Contribuer aux sujets de code quality, SAST et artifact management
  • Participer à la migration d’applications on-premise vers Azure
  • Accompagner les équipes de développement dans l’adoption de bonnes pratiques
  • Apporter un support technique à des équipes métier travaillant sur des sujets de calcul et de prévision
  • Améliorer la qualité, la lisibilité et la maintenabilité du code Python
  • Favoriser une collaboration fluide entre les équipes techniques et métier


Profil :

Compétences principales

  • DevOps
  • CI/CD
  • Python
  • Azure

Compétences complémentaires

  • Terraform
  • GitLab
  • SAST
  • Connaissance des enjeux de qualité de code
  • Expérience de la migration cloud


📍 Informations pratiques

  • Contrat : CDI
  • Langues : Français & Anglais (B2+)
  • Démarrage : Dès que possible


Les étapes pour nous rencontrer :

  1. Premier contact : Notre équipe de chargés de recrutement est à votre écoute pour comprendre votre parcours et vos attentes 🎧.
  2. Entretien technique : Échangez avec un de nos collaborateurs pour parler technique 🛠️.
  3. Entretien avec un Business Manager : Découvrez les missions et projets en détail 🎯.


Pourquoi choisir Qim info ?

  • Expertise reconnue : Activité dans une dizaine de secteurs et une connaissance des métiers de l’IT 🌐.
  • Suivi RH & managérial de qualité : Accompagnement dans votre montée en compétences et vos missions au quotidien 🌟.
  • Culture d’entreprise : Partagez plus qu’une pause-café ! Qim tech talks, soirées annuelles et trimestrielles, Afterwork Qim... de nombreux événements sont organisés chaque année 🎉.
  • Satisfaction des consultants : Chez Qim info, on est bien et ce sont nos consultants qui le disent mieux que nous sur Glassdoor (note de 4,1/5) 🌟.


Vous souhaitez en savoir plus ? 🔍

  • Nous attendons avec impatience votre candidature !

json.title: DevOps / IT Infrastructure Engineer
json.descriptionHtml:
OneDoc is the leading healthcare platform in Switzerland. Today, more than 13,000 healthcare professionals and 3 million patients use our services every day. You may even be one of them!

Our mission is simple: make interactions between health professionals and patients easier. To achieve this, we rely on a young and dynamic team of more than 80 people across five offices in Switzerland.


The Role

We are looking for a DevOps / IT Infrastructure Engineer who is passionate about designing, building, and maintaining scalable, secure, and reliable cloud infrastructure. This is a role with real ownership: you won’t just support systems, you will shape how our infrastructure evolves, ensuring full observability and helping ensure our platforms run smoothly and efficiently.

Position Overview:

  • Contract type: Permanent
  • Employment type: Full-time (100%)
  • Location: Geneva / Lausanne
  • Start date: As soon as possible
  • Work model: Hybrid (3 days on-site / 2 days remote)


Key Missions

Design and manage infrastructure

You will design, implement, and maintain cloud-based infrastructure, ensuring reliability, scalability, and security for our SaaS platform.

Automate and optimize workflows

You will implement CI/CD pipelines, automation scripts, and monitoring tools to improve deployment speed, system reliability, and operational efficiency.

Ensure security and compliance

You will maintain system security, backups, and compliance standards, and collaborate with teams to proactively identify and mitigate risks.

Drive Observability & Monitoring

You will design and implement robust monitoring, logging and alerting to ensure real-time visibility into system health, performance, and user experience.

Collaborate across teams

Work closely with the CTO, developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to translate business needs into resilient infrastructure solutions.

Continuous improvement

Stay up to date with DevOps and cloud best practices, introduce new tools and processes, and continuously enhance performance and reliability.

Be part of a high-performing team

Join a collaborative team that values ownership, problem-solving, and meaningful impact.


Your Profile

You can be our next DevOps / IT Infrastructure Engineer if:

  • You have a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
  • You have at least 3 years of experience in DevOps
  • You are proficient with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
  • You have experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • You have knowledge of Ansible, Terraform, or similar automation tools
  • You are experienced with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitLab CI, etc.)
  • You have hands-on experience with monitoring and logging tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, OpenSearch, etc.)
  • You are skilled in Linux systems administration and networking
  • You have strong problem-solving skills and a proactive attitude
  • You are committed to best practices in security, scalability, and maintainable infrastructure
  • You are fluent in English (French is a plus)


Recruiting Process

We care deeply about offering a transparent, respectful, and human hiring experience. Here’s what you can expect:

  1. Introductory call with HR: Get to know each other, review your background, and discuss your motivations.
  2. Technical discussion: Deep dive with a tech lead or infrastructure manager to discuss your experience, approach, and problem-solving skills.
  3. Practical exercise: You may receive an exercise to demonstrate your ability to design and manage infrastructure solutions.
  4. Reference checks: We speak with former colleagues or managers to understand your team impact.


What We Offer

Time to rest – 5 weeks of paid vacation to recharge.

Commute support – SBB Half Fare travel card reimbursement.

Flexible hybrid working – Work from home and office in a way that fits your life.

Team bonding – Ping-pong, table football, and a fully stocked kitchen.

Celebrations – Monthly office events to relax and connect.

Annual offsite – Two-day team retreat in the Swiss mountains.

Strong team culture – Join a team of talented and driven people who support each other, share knowledge, and take pride in building impactful solutions together.


Ready to shape the future of healthcare infrastructure with us?

json.title: DevOps Engineer 80–100 %
json.descriptionHtml:
Gestalte die digitale Zukunft der Schweiz mit uns. In unserem Vorhaben arbeiten wir sowohl an modernen als auch an etablierten Steuerlösungen und treiben deren Weiterentwicklung sowie den erfolgreichen Einsatz bei neuen und bestehenden Kunden aktiv voran. Du willst dabei nicht nur Systeme betreiben, sondern aktiv Plattformen mitgestalten? Dich begeistern Automatisierung, Cloud-native Technologien und der Anspruch, nachhaltige Lösungen zu schaffen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Deine Rolle

  • Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für unsere Kubernetes-Cluster und entwickelst diese kontinuierlich weiter
  • Du stellst einen hohen Automatisierungsgrad über den gesamten Software- und Plattform Lifecycle sicher
  • Du konzipierst, implementierst und betreibst leistungsfähige CI/CD-Pipelines und optimierst diese fortlaufend
  • Du führst Monitoring- und Logging-Lösungen ein und entwickelst diese weiter, um Transparenz und Stabilität sicherzustellen
  • Du unterstützt und berätst Entwicklungsteams bei infrastrukturellen Fragestellungen sowie bei der Umsetzung von DevOps-Praktiken
  • Du definierst und etablierst DevOps-Standards und sorgst für deren teamübergreifende Umsetzung
  • Du arbeitest eng mit anderen DevOps Engineers sowie der Softwarearchitektur zusammen
  • Du treibst die Modernisierung bestehender Services voran – insbesondere die Migration von VM-basierten Deployments in Kubernetes
  • Du erarbeitest technische Konzepte und bringst neue Ideen aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Plattform ein

Dein Profil

  • Abgeschlossene IT-Ausbildung, Studium im IT-Bereich oder vergleichbare praktische Erfahrung
  • Mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung als DevOps Engineer
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse im Bereich Kubernetes, Helm und containerbasierter Plattformen
  • Erfahrung mit CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code sowie Automatisierungslösungen
  • Know-how in Monitoring- und Logging-Tools
  • Idealerweise Erfahrung mit Cloud-Technologien und modernen Plattformarchitekturen
  • Strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie Interesse an kontinuierlicher Verbesserung
  • Freude an Zusammenarbeit, Wissensaustausch und teamübergreifender Kommunikation
  • Bereitschaft für Pikettdienst (ca. alle 5 Wochen)

Deine Benefits

  • Sehr tolles Team, bei dem Zusammenarbeit Spass macht.
  • Moderner Arbeitsplatz in St. Gallen beim Bahnhof oder im Circle am Flughafen Zürich
  • Bis zu 60 % Home-Office bei einem 100 % Pensum möglich
  • Ferienkauf (2 Wochen pro Jahr)
  • 41h Woche mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten bei einem Vollzeitpensum
  • Mind. 25 Tage Ferien pro Jahr
  • Förderung von Weiterbildungen zu 100 % finanziell oder zeitlich
  • Kostenloses SBB-Halbtax-Abo für alle Mitarbeitenden

json.descriptionHtml:
At BairesDev®, we've been leading the way in technology projects for over 15 years. We deliver cutting-edge solutions to giants like Google and the most innovative startups in Silicon Valley.

Our diverse 4,000+ team, composed of the world's Top 1% of tech talent, works remotely on roles that drive significant impact worldwide.

When you apply for this position, you're taking the first step in a process that goes beyond the ordinary. We aim to align your passions and skills with our vacancies, setting you on a path to exceptional career development and success.

Senior Data Platform Engineer at BairesDev

We’re looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer who writes Java and has built the kind of distributed data infrastructure that large-scale analytics and processing workloads actually depend on. You’ve worked with Spark or similar frameworks, you understand how data platforms behave in Kubernetes-native cloud environments, and you know what it takes to keep them running reliably under pressure. You’ll be contributing to open source data platform technology used by leading enterprises worldwide to process and manage data at scale.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and maintain data platform components in Java that support large-scale distributed Spark workloads.
  • Design and optimize data processing pipelines running in Kubernetes-native cloud environments.
  • Work on platform reliability, observability, and performance across distributed data infrastructure.
  • Identify and resolve performance and scalability issues in data platform components.
  • Collaborate with data engineering and platform teams to deliver high-quality platform features.
  • Contribute to technical discussions, code reviews, and platform engineering standards.

What We Are Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in IT roles.
  • 3+ years of experience with Java as a primary language in data platform or distributed systems contexts.
  • Hands-on experience with Apache Spark or similar distributed data processing frameworks.
  • Solid foundation in distributed systems design and operation.
  • Experience working in Kubernetes or containerized cloud deployments.
  • Advanced proficiency in English.

How we do make your work (and your life) easier:

  • Remote Work.
  • Excellent compensation in USD or your local currency if preferred
  • Hardware and software setup for you to work from home.
  • Flexible hours: create your own schedule.
  • Paid parental leaves, vacations, and national holidays.
  • Innovative and multicultural work environment: collaborate and learn from the global Top 1% of talent.
  • Supportive environment with mentorship, promotions, skill development, and diverse growth opportunities.

Join a global team where your unique talents can truly thrive and make a significant impact!

Apply now!

#BD-PRIO-2026

json.title: Platform Engineer
json.descriptionHtml:
A high-impact engineering opportunity is available with an international technology company operating a mission-critical engagement platform.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Platform ownership: Design, operate, monitor, and troubleshoot Kubernetes-based services (Kubernetes/Helm), with a strong automation-first mindset.​
  • Reliability & observability: Improve alerting, monitoring, logging, and performance using Prometheus, Grafana, and Elastic/ELK.​
  • Infrastructure operations: Administer Linux (Debian) environments and handle network troubleshooting (TCP/IP).​
  • Automation & CI/CD: Build Infrastructure-as-Code with Terraform/Tofu and Ansible; support CI/CD practices and tooling (e.g., GitLab/TeamCity, Git, Maven).​
  • Virtualization & storage: Collaborate closely with infrastructure teams on Proxmox virtualization and Ceph/ZFS storage platforms.​

Profile:

  • Experience: Strong production experience with cloud-native platforms (Kubernetes...).
  • Core ops skills: Confident Linux administration (Debian).
  • Networking expertise (TCP/IP, firewall and troubleshooting)​.
  • DevOps discipline: Proven automation/IaC approach (Terraform/Tofu, Ansible) and CI/CD toolchain experience (GitLab/TeamCity, Git, Maven).​
  • Observability: Hands-on monitoring/logging across Prometheus/Grafana and Elastic/ELK.​
  • Fluent English and German a plus.

Apply for the Platform Engineer position if you believe this could be your next challenge.

- Platform ownership: Design, operate, monitor, and troubleshoot Kubernetes-based services (Kubernetes/Helm), with a strong automation-first mindset. 
- Reliability & observability: Improve alerting, monitoring, logging, and performance using Prometheus, Grafana, and Elastic/ELK. 
- Infrastructure operations: Administer Linux (Debian) environments and handle network troubleshooting (TCP/IP). 
- Automation & CI/CD: Build Infrastructure-as-Code with Terraform/Tofu and Ansible; support CI/CD practices and tooling (e.g., GitLab/TeamCity, Git, Maven). 
- Virtualization & storage: Collaborate closely with infrastructure teams on Proxmox virtualization and Ceph/ZFS storage platforms. 

Profile



- Experience: Strong production experience with cloud-native platforms (Kubernetes...).
- Core ops skills: Confident Linux administration (Debian).
- Networking expertise (TCP/IP, firewall and troubleshooting) .
- DevOps discipline: Proven automation/IaC approach (Terraform/Tofu, Ansible) and CI/CD toolchain experience (GitLab/TeamCity, Git, Maven). 
- Observability: Hands-on monitoring/logging across Prometheus/Grafana and Elastic/ELK. 
- Fluent English and German a plus.

Apply for the Platform Engineer position if you believe this could be your next challenge.

json.title: Senior Software Engineer, Calendar Serving Search Quality
json.descriptionHtml:
Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. 3-5 year of experience with software development in one or more programming languages (e.g., Python, C, C++, Java, JavaScript).
  • 3-5 year of experience with software development in one or more programming languages (e.g., Python, C, C++, Java, JavaScript).
  • 3-5 year of experience with data structures or algorithms. 1-3 year of experience implementing ML concepts

Preferred qualifications:

  • Search Infrastructure
  • Search Quality
  • Google Workspace
  • Machine Learning

About the jobA line of code can be many things - an amazing feature, a beautiful UI, a transformative algorithm. The faster this line of code reaches millions of users, the sooner it impacts their lives. As a Software Engineer, Tools and Infrastructure, you will be at the heart of Google’s engineering process building software that empowers engineering teams to develop and deliver high quality products quickly. We are focused on solving the hardest, most interesting challenges of developing software at scale without sacrificing stability, quality, velocity or code health.

We ensure Google's success by partnering with engineering teams and developing scalable tools and infrastructure that help engineers develop, test, debug and release software quickly. We impact thousands of Googlers and billions of users by increasing the pace of product development and ensuring our products are thoroughly tested. We are advocates for code health, testability, maintainability and best practices for development and testing.

Having access to all of Google's platforms and vast compute resources provides a unique opportunity to grow as an engineer. We typically work in small, nimble teams that collaborate on common problems across products and focus areas. As a result, the exposure to this broad set of problems provides technical challenges as well as accelerated career growth.

The Calendar Backend Serving team is responsible for Calendar's synchronous backend serving stack, focusing on real-time request and response handling. This includes managing the data model, Spanner storage, low-level business logic, and ensuring reliability, low latency, and data consistency. The team develops and maintains critical internal and external APIs, such as CoreAPI, Rosy, and CalDav, as well as the integration into the workspace agentic search stack.The Google Cloud AI Research team addresses AI challenges motivated by Google Cloud’s mission of bringing AI to tech, healthcare, finance, retail and many other industries. We work on a range of unique problems focused on research topics that maximize scientific and real-world impact, aiming to push the state-of-the-art in AI and share findings with the broader research community. We also collaborate with product teams to bring innovations to real-world impact that benefits our customers.

Responsibilities

    • Evaluation Framework
    • Quality Loss Analysis
    • Calendar Corpus Optimization
    • Calendar Corpus Adoption
    • Cross-Functional Strategy

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

json.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (Remote Build)
json.descriptionHtml:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (Remote Build) based in Switzerland.

This role sits at the intersection of engineering, customer delivery, and applied AI, where you will directly partner with enterprise clients to turn complex operational challenges into reliable, production-grade systems. You will design and deploy integrations, automations, and AI-powered workflows that connect enterprise tools with modern platforms. The position requires strong ownership across the full lifecycle—from discovery and architecture to deployment, monitoring, and iteration. You will operate in ambiguous, fast-moving environments, translating real-world customer needs into scalable technical solutions. A key part of the role is building trust with stakeholders while ensuring solutions are robust, secure, and measurable in production. You will also help standardize learnings from the field into reusable frameworks and engineering best practices. This is a high-impact role in a remote-first, highly collaborative environment focused on practical AI deployment at scale.

Accountabilities

  • Partner with customers to deeply understand business challenges, define success criteria, and run structured technical discovery sessions that translate needs into clear “definition of done” outcomes.
  • Design and implement end-to-end technical solutions including APIs, data pipelines, integrations, and workflow automations that integrate customer systems with internal platforms.
  • Own production deployments, ensuring reliability, observability, performance, incident response readiness, and continuous improvement of delivered systems.
  • Build and maintain AI-enabled systems using LLMs, agentic workflows, retrieval patterns, and evaluation frameworks to ensure safe, accurate, and efficient outputs.
  • Develop measurement frameworks including KPIs, test suites, regression checks, and guardrails to evaluate system quality and business impact.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success teams to refine architecture, improve reusable components, and scale solutions.
  • Translate field insights into scalable patterns, playbooks, and product feedback to improve platform capabilities over time.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience shipping production-grade software as a backend or full-stack engineer, with ownership of systems in live environments (including debugging and on-call responsibility).
  • Strong systems design and integration expertise including APIs, webhooks, authentication (OAuth/service accounts), event-driven architectures, data modeling, and failure handling.
  • Hands-on experience building with applied AI/LLMs in production, including prompt design, tool use, RAG, evaluation methods, and performance trade-offs.
  • Ability to operate independently in ambiguous environments, translating undefined problems into structured technical solutions and execution plans.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working with enterprise-grade environments is a plus, including compliance, security reviews, and large-scale system constraints.
  • Familiarity with HRIS, payroll, IAM systems, multi-tenant SaaS, or similar enterprise domains is highly desirable.
  • Strong programming proficiency and ability to work across multiple languages and modern backend frameworks.

Benefits

  • Fully remote-first working model with flexibility to work from anywhere
  • Flexible working hours with async-first culture supporting work-life balance
  • Competitive compensation with equity/stock options depending on role level
  • Paid parental leave and comprehensive mental health support programs
  • Learning and development budget to support continuous upskilling
  • Home office setup budget and equipment support
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI and enterprise integration challenges
  • Global, high-trust environment with strong ownership and autonomy

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

json.title: Deputy CTO (AI Product)
json.descriptionHtml:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Deputy CTO (AI Product) based in Switzerland.

This is a high-impact technical leadership role at the intersection of engineering, architecture, and product execution. You will act as the right hand to the CTO, helping steer backend and ML teams while remaining deeply hands-on in development and delivery. The role combines strategic ownership of system architecture with the ability to prototype and ship code when needed. You will translate complex business challenges into scalable technical solutions and lead small, focused teams toward fast execution. Operating in a fast-moving, globally distributed environment, you will ensure alignment across engineering, product, and infrastructure. This position is ideal for a senior technologist who thrives in both leadership and hands-on engineering and enjoys solving ambiguous, evolving problems.

Accountabilities

  • Act as deputy to the CTO, representing technical leadership across backend and ML teams when required, ensuring continuity of vision and execution.
  • Own end-to-end architecture and technical decision-making for products and features, ensuring scalability, performance, and reliability.
  • Remain hands-on in development, actively writing code, shipping features, and building prototypes to validate solutions.
  • Translate business needs into technical execution plans, leading small teams (5-10 engineers) from concept to delivery.
  • Lead and support people operations including hiring, offboarding, resourcing, compensation input, and team coordination.
  • Drive cross-team alignment with senior stakeholders to ensure synchronization across technical and product priorities.
  • Oversee infrastructure and operational responsibilities, ensuring systems are robust, maintainable, and efficient in a fast-changing environment.

Requirements

  • Strong backend engineering background with deep understanding of system architecture; experience in C#, Python, Java, or similar backend technologies.
  • Proven ability to remain hands-on in coding while operating in a senior technical leadership or management role.
  • Solid business acumen with the ability to connect technical decisions to product and business outcomes.
  • Demonstrated experience in people management, including hiring, team leadership, and resource allocation.
  • Comfortable working across the full engineering lifecycle: architecture, development, infrastructure, and operations.
  • Startup mindset with the ability to thrive in fast-paced, small-team environments and lead by example.
  • Strong curiosity and continuous learning mindset, with willingness to experiment and adopt new technologies.
  • Excellent communication skills with clear, structured thinking and the ability to articulate uncertainty when needed.
  • 8+ years of relevant experience in software engineering and technical leadership roles.

Benefits

  • Remote full-time opportunity with flexible working arrangements.
  • Compensation details shared transparently during the recruitment process prior to employment.
  • 28 calendar days of annual vacation.
  • 7 additional wellness days per year for personal recovery and household needs.
  • Referral bonuses of up to $5,000 for successful candidate recommendations.
  • 50% coverage of professional training, conferences, and industry events.
  • Corporate discounts for English language learning programs.

json.title: Senior AI Tech Consultant (all genders) - BCG Platinion Zurich, Switzerland
json.descriptionHtml:
Do you want to turn the challenges of digital and AI-driven transformations into the solutions of the future? Join BCG Platinion and help tackle the core IT issues of leading global companies. We help clients accelerate tech transformation - from tech and AI strategy to scalable architectures, platforms, and solutions that create real business impact. Bring your individual strengths to a team where everyone builds AI fluency while contributing diverse expertise and perspectives. As an integrated part of Boston Consulting Group, we work with BCG and our clients to turn digital visions into reality.

Shape the world of tomorrow

  • You'll shape the digital transformation of globally leading companies, ensuring their success by evaluating our clients' digital capabilities and performing feasibility studies
  • You'll analyze, develop, and optimize cutting-edge, customized IT architectures while leading small teams and applying your comprehensive understanding of legacy IT, enterprise solutions, and current market developments and trends such as cloud computing and microservices
  • You'll manage small, agile development teams in strategic IT implementation programs, establish modern practices like DevOps and CI/CD, and be responsible for the technical implementation of crucial digital requirements such as cyber resilience
  • You'll work in an AI-enabled environment — leveraging AI tools on client projects and supporting our clients in building their own AI capabilities

This Is How You Make a Difference

  • You completed a degree in computer science, (business) informatics, or a related discipline with higher-than-average grades
  • You have at least four years of relevant experience in IT Consulting, in the course of which you implemented transformation and implementation projects in terms of both strategy and operations
  • Ideally, you have industry-specific knowledge or (project) experience in the banking, insurance or healthcare sector
  • You also have experience in leading project teams of more than three people
  • You know exactly what the buzzwords machine learning, cyber resilience, DevOps, agile, AI, and robotics mean
  • You have initial hands-on experience working with AI tools and are eager to deepen your AI fluency in a professional context
  • You are familiar with all the stages of development for successful IT organizations and IT processes
  • You know exactly how to put together complex business cases
  • You feel particularly comfortable in interdisciplinary teams and global contexts and are flexible and willing to travel
  • You're good at understanding and communicating complex topics in both German and English; French is an advantage

How To Grow With Us

We guarantee constant new development incentives in an open and rewarding work environment. You'll face challenges every day together with a dedicated team of talented colleagues. Individual training offers and a culture of open feedback will provide the framework you need to explore and perfect your own strengths. Our modern structures enable you to stay focused. This includes easy travel booking, our excellent back-office support and a comprehensive Knowledge Center. With our regular office Fridays and legendary events, we cultivate a strong and close team network from which you will also profit beyond your case work.

To support your growth in the AI space, we provide state-of-the-art hard- and software infrastructure for your work, as well as a comprehensive AI enablement training program that equips you with the skills to thrive in an AI-driven world.

Become a part of our team

BCG Platinion is an Equal Opportunity Employer and actively promotes diversity and inclusion. We consider all qualified applicants regardless of ethnic and social background, age, gender, sexual identity, religion, ideology or disability.

Apply now with your CV, an informative project list and all relevant references via our online portal or contact David Körte (+49 221 58958-555) if you have any questions.

Further information at www.bcgplatinion.com/careers?local=de

json.descriptionHtml:
Google welcomes people with disabilities.

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: Zürich, Switzerland; Paris, France.Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 6 years of experience with cloud-native architecture in technical delivery, customer engineering, or enterprise architecture and in a customer-facing or enterprise support role.
  • Experience in technical deployment planning, architecture orchestration, or technical delivery management.
  • Experience with enterprise integrations (APIs, ECMs, identity), Cloud infrastructure, and AI/ML model deployments.
  • Experience with programming languages, API integration, debugging, or enterprise systems design.
  • Experience leading technical delivery strategies, debugging systems, and interfacing with product/engineering organizations.

Preferred qualifications:

  • L300/L400 level technical proficiency or relevant AI/ML and Cloud architecture certifications.
  • Experience guiding customers through the architectural and organizational transformations needed to deploy production-grade AI models or agents in enterprise environments.
  • Technical experience in one or more of the following: Cloud AI solutions, Enterprise Data Management, Data Analytics, Infrastructure Modernization, Security, or Cloud Networking.
  • Ability to dive deep into novel technical problems, decipher extreme ambiguity, diagnose bugs, and emerge with credible architectural solution.
  • Proven track record interfacing directly with core product and engineering organizations to escalate product bugs, advocate for feature gaps, and unblock systemic deployments.

About The Job

The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.

As an AI Outcome Customer Engineer (AI OCE), you will drive initial and ongoing revenue ramp for our enterprise customers, clearing complex blockers and ensuring they realize maximum business value from their Cloud AI investments faster. You will manage and execute the technical deployment plan, transitioning scoped license agreements into robust production deployments by providing authoritative technical leadership to customers and partners.

You will have a direct impact on the velocity and incremental consumption of customer agreements, leading to accelerated value realization, higher adoption, and future expansion opportunities. You will blend sales acumen, enterprise architecture knowledge, technical engagement, and technical delivery management to prove and scale the value of Google's premier Cloud AI solutions.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

France: €100000 - €103000 (EUR) + 42.86% bonus target + equity + benefits

Responsibilities

Learn more about benefits at Google .

  • Develop and orchestrate a structured, end-to-end technical deployment plan across customer and partner teams. Lead upfront architectural validation to ensure integration readiness before execution begins.
  • Dive into complex technical workflows to diagnose, debug, and resolve implementation roadblocks. Act as a technical bridge to core product and support engineering teams to eliminate systemic friction and accelerate customer delivery.
  • Drive and track the progress of the initial and ongoing ramp of Cloud AI license agreements, guiding enterprise workloads from agreement to active consumption as rapidly and securely as possible.
  • Partner collaboratively with Account an CEs team during the technical evaluation phase of key deals to ensure proposed Cloud AI solutions are architected for viable, scalable long-term adoption.
  • Drive sustainable, secure Cloud AI product usage to help customers continuously realize quantifiable business outcomes and secure future contract renewals.


Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

json.title: Platform Engineer
json.descriptionHtml:
We are expanding Duferco’s Corporate Innovation Team: a fast-moving engineering team operating in a startup-like environment, backed by the stability and scale of a global diversified group.


You will work across multiple companies and domains inside the group — including energy, trading, logistics, steel, insurance, sports, and other sectors — helping build and operate the cloud infrastructure, deployment systems, automation platforms, and internal developer tooling that power our next generation of software and AI-enabled systems.


We are looking for a DevOps / Platform Engineer with strong infrastructure and automation skills who wants to help design highly autonomous, resilient, and scalable systems. This role is not limited to maintaining infrastructure: you will actively shape how engineering, operations, AI automation, and internal platforms evolve across the organization.

About the Team

We sit close to real business problems and have the freedom to prototype and ship quickly. AI is already part of our daily workflow, and we expect that role to keep expanding.

We care about building things well, shipping systems that create leverage, and working with people who make the team better.

We appreciate engineers who enjoy ownership, fast iteration, pragmatic problem solving, and AI-assisted development.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and maintain AWS-based infrastructure using services such as ECS, Fargate, EC2, Lambda, EKS, RDS, S3, CloudFront, API Gateway, IAM, and related services
  • Design and manage Kubernetes-based workloads and containerized environments
  • Develop Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and/or AWS CDK
  • Build CI/CD pipelines and developer workflows using GitHub Actions and related tooling
  • Create infrastructure automation systems focused on scalability, reliability, self-healing, and operational efficiency
  • Improve observability, monitoring, alerting, deployment safety, and operational tooling
  • Collaborate closely with software engineers, data engineers, and AI teams to enable fast and reliable delivery
  • Develop AI-enabled operational automation, internal agents, MCP-based integrations, and autonomous workflows to reduce manual operational overhead
  • Help evolve the organization toward a more autonomous engineering and infrastructure stack
  • Evaluate and adopt modern cloud, platform engineering, and AI-native infrastructure approaches where they provide real leverage


What We Offer

  • A high-autonomy role with direct influence on what gets built
  • Modern AI-assisted engineering tools and time to explore new technologies and approaches
  • A fast-moving, collaborative environment with talented and ambitious people
  • A broad variety of technical and business challenges across different domains
  • Competitive compensation and benefits
  • Flexible working hours and hybrid work setup


You’re Probably a Fit If

  • You have 4+ years working with cloud infrastructure and production systems, particularly on AWS
  • You are comfortable designing and operating containerized workloads using Docker, ECS, Kubernetes, or similar technologies
  • You have strong experience with Infrastructure such as Code using Terraform, AWS CDK, or equivalent tools
  • You have experience building and maintaining CI/CD systems, preferably with GitHub Actions
  • You think in terms of automation first, and naturally look for ways to eliminate repetitive operational work
  • You are comfortable debugging distributed systems, infrastructure failures, networking issues, and deployment problems in production environments
  • You care about reliability, scalability, observability, and developer experience — not just “keeping servers running”
  • You actively use AI coding and automation tools — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, MCP-enabled workflows, or similar — and are interested in how AI changes infrastructure and operations workflows
  • You make pragmatic trade-offs between speed, maintainability, operational simplicity, and engineering rigor
  • You enjoy working across infrastructure, software, automation, and internal tooling rather than staying inside a narrow operational silo

Experience with platform engineering, Kubernetes operators, observability stacks, event-driven systems, internal developer platforms, LLM applications, agent frameworks, MCP servers, or large-scale automation systems is a strong plus.


You do not need experience with every technology we use. Strong engineering ability, adaptability, curiosity, and a strong automation mindset matter much more.


If this sounds like the right fit for you, we’d love to hear from you.


Interested candidates are invited to apply via the following link:

https://duferco.talentics.ai/job/7d3cb7f4-0255-411c-98c5-92ad1132c9b1

json.title: XR Audio Face Tracking ML Software Engineer
json.descriptionHtml:
Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a similar technical field of study, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience programming in Python.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Applied Math, or a related field with a focus on machine learning.
  • Experience with deep learning frameworks (e.g., JAX) and edge frameworks (e.g. LiteRT).
  • Experience with polygonal mesh representations and skeletal animation pipelines.
  • Proficiency with Python/C++ .

About The Job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

With your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.

For decades, the computing revolution has reshaped our world driven by breakthroughs in compute, connectivity, mobile, and now, AI. Google's XR team is at the forefront of the next major leap – the convergence of AI and XR. This is more than just new devices – it's about reimagining how we interact with the world around us. In this role, you will be building a future where lightweight XR devices pair with helpful AI to augment human intelligence, offering personalized, conversational, and contextually aware experiences.

For decades, the computing revolution has reshaped our world driven by

breakthroughs in compute, connectivity, mobile, and now, AI. Google's XR team is at the forefront of the next major leap – the convergence of AI and XR. This is more than just new devices – it's about reimagining how we interact with the world around us. We're building a future where

lightweight XR devices like smart glasses and headsets pair with helpful AI to augment human intelligence, offering personalized, conversational, and contextually aware experiences.

Responsibilities

  • Research and develop algorithms and models for tracking and synthesizing facial motion from multimodal inputs.
  • Work with data collection and synthesis teams to gather high-quality training data.
  • Optimize models and algorithms to run on low-power XR devices in real time.
  • Propose KPIs and metrics, and incorporate user feedback into the algorithm and model design.
  • Be able to work alongside other software engineers and research scientists to deliver production-ready models and pipelines.


Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer.
