json.title: Technical Project Manager
json.descriptionHtml:
We're all about helping brands turn ideas into impact.


Frontify’s brand platform transforms how teams organize digital assets, collaborate on projects, and create engaging campaigns. Our people empower thousands of marketers and designers — including teams at Uber, Microsoft, Volkswagen, and Telefónica — to build engaging brands.


With headquarters in St. Gallen, Switzerland, and offices in London and New York City, we share a vibrant culture built on creativity, collaboration, inclusion, and joy. And we’re on the lookout for new team members to share our vision. If you’re ready for a brand-new adventure, keep reading!


Your team

Your new team is a group of motivated, collaborative, and innovative people from all over the world. They enjoy working together to create and evolve a well-loved product but always keep room for new ideas and approaches. Outside of work, some of them are parents, gamers, bookworms, adrenaline junkies, and so much more!


Your mission

As a Technical Project Manager, you'll sit at the intersection of partner delivery and internal operations, helping turn priorities into shipped work that drives Frontify forward. This is an execution-first role where you'll own the processes, systems, and follow-through that keep projects moving and commitments on track.


You'll split your time between managing the operational delivery of external partner integrations and leading internal technical projects that improve how we work. From contracts and onboarding to development tracking, QA, and launch coordination, you'll ensure partner integrations are delivered successfully and on time. At the same time, you'll help shape AI-first workflows and strengthen the connections across our internal tool stack to improve efficiency and scale.


When priorities compete, you'll focus on partner delivery first — ensuring external commitments are met while building the foundations that enable our teams to work smarter over time.


Your Responsibilities

Partner integration delivery

  • You'll own the operational lifecycle of partner integrations, including contracts, statements of work (SOWs), service-level agreements (SLAs), payments, renewals, and delivery coordination.
  • You'll provision and manage partner environments and tooling access.
  • You'll run development cadences, including weekly check-ins, milestone tracking, and blocker resolution.
  • You'll coordinate QA processes and manage formal acceptance against agreed SOW deliverables.
  • You'll partner with Product Marketing Management (PMM) to support launches through documentation, enablement materials, and launch readiness activities.
  • You'll bridge partner launches into go-to-market activities and ensure smooth delivery through launch and beyond.
  • You'll triage post-launch issues and manage ongoing maintenance relationships with partners.


Internal technical projects

  • You'll scope and manage projects that build AI-first internal workflows, taking initiatives from brief through to a working process with clear ownership.
  • You'll own integrations across Frontify's internal tool stack, including platforms such as Slite, Linear, Figma, Claude, and others.
  • You'll identify operational and technical gaps in our ways of working and proactively solve them before they become larger challenges.
  • You'll improve how systems, tools, and teams work together to increase efficiency and execution quality across the organization.


Your story

  • You can work in a hybrid format where you’re able to work on-site in our St Gallen office once a week, and then choose where works best for you for the rest of the week.
  • You're a highly effective implementer who enjoys turning plans into outcomes and consistently follows through on commitments.
  • You move quickly, close feedback loops, and take ownership of work without needing constant direction or reminders.
  • You have excellent written and verbal communication skills and enjoy connecting stakeholders across Product Management, Product Design, Product Marketing, partners, and other teams.
  • You understand API concepts, authentication flows, and large language model (LLM) tooling well enough to ask thoughtful questions and identify weak implementations.
  • You have hands-on experience building automations or workflows using low-code and integration tools such as n8n, Make, or Zapier, or you're eager to develop that expertise.
  • You're comfortable working independently, creating structure where needed, and driving ambiguous projects from idea to execution.
  • You know how to introduce lightweight processes that improve outcomes without creating unnecessary bureaucracy or overhead.
  • You're highly organized and reliable, and can successfully balance routine operational responsibilities with more open-ended project work.
  • You influence and drive progress through clarity, persistence, and strong stakeholder management rather than formal authority.
  • You're comfortable holding partners accountable, managing scope against agreed SOWs, pushing back on scope creep, and escalating commercial challenges when appropriate.


We understand that every candidate’s experience is different. If you’re interested in this role but don’t tick all the boxes, we still encourage you to apply.


Why join us?

  • Thrive with the tools and support to shape your future at Frontify.
  • Be part of a product that connects brands and people with a human touch.
  • Enjoy flexibility, opportunities to grow, and exposure to innovative technologies and ideas.
  • Join a vibrant, social team—whether you love animals, yoga, or travel, we’ve got the Slack channels for you!


What We Offer

  • A minimum of 25 days annual leave per year
  • Parental, family care, and bereavement leave
  • Daily sickness benefits and accident insurance
  • Paid educational and wellbeing days off
  • Wellbeing, learning and development, and commuter allowance
  • Home office setup budget
  • Pension fund: contributions paid 60% by us and 40% by you
  • Access to exclusive perks and discounts from hundreds of top brands
  • Workation: Work from inspiring locations around the world for up to 45 days per year!
  • Invite to our summer company meet-up


Important to us

Frontify is a place where authenticity and inclusion thrive, empowering every voice to help shape our future.


We’re committed to an inclusive hiring experience. If you need any support or adjustments during the recruitment process, please let your Talent Partner know when scheduling. Any information shared will be treated confidentially.


Next steps

If there’s a fit, you’ll meet our Talent Partner to discuss your experience and explore whether Frontify is the right place for you.


This description outlines the primary duties of the role, which may evolve in response to business needs and company growth. We’re looking for someone comfortable with change and excited to contribute to a dynamic environment. If this sounds like you, come join us and help shape what’s next.


We may conduct preliminary checks for successful candidates, depending on the role and in line with local laws. We’ll share all relevant details during the interview process.


We use third party artificial intelligence (AI) tools to record and transcribe interviews and to help our team review candidate profiles. These tools do not replace human judgment, and all evaluations and final hiring decisions are made by our recruitment team. Please see our Privacy Notice for more information about how we process your data, and how to exercise your privacy rights

json.title: Legal Engineer
json.descriptionHtml:
Why Omnilex?

At Omnilex, we’re on a mission to transform the way lawyers work. Our AI-native platform lets legal professionals enhance their productivity in legal research and automate workflows. We collaborate closely with our clients and iterate at a market-leading pace. In a year, we have gone from an early MVP to a product used daily by thousands of legal professionals at our clients in Switzerland, Germany and Liechtenstein - and are now scaling rapidly across Europe.

You’ll be joining a young, passionate and dynamic team of 15, with roots at ETH Zurich.

Joining Omnilex at this early stage you will have a large responsibility from day one with an unlimited potential to grow personally and professionally together with the team.


Your role

  • At Omnilex, you are the person who turns a cautious law firm into a firm-wide rollout
  • You will own the success of our most important accounts from first test to full deployment by sitting deep inside their workflows, understanding what they actually need, and making sure Omnilex delivers it
  • You are the connective tissue between practicing lawyers and our engineering team. What you hear in client sessions shapes what we build next
  • This is a high-impact, high-autonomy role for someone who wants to own outcomes, not just manage relationships


What you'll do

  • Turn key accounts into firm-wide rollouts
  • Own the testing and rollout process at our most strategic accounts
  • Consult law firms on how to integrate Omnilex into their actual workflows
  • Identify what is blocking adoption and remove those blockers, one by one
  • Be the person inside the firm that champions the rollout from pilot to full deployment
  • Translate legal practice into product direction
  • Capture what lawyers struggle with, what they ask for, and what they work around
  • Bring structured, prioritized feedback directly into the product roadmap
  • Sync regularly with engineering to explain the legal context behind every request
  • Spot patterns across accounts. If three firms hit the same wall, that's a product problem
  • Be the expert in the room
  • Run working sessions with lawyers to demonstrate how Omnilex fits their specific practice
  • Explain new features in legal terms, not technical ones. That can be in form of written materials, webinars and other


What success looks like

  • Key accounts that started with a pilot are running Omnilex firm-wide
  • The product roadmap reflects real, validated needs from practicing lawyers
  • Engineering knows exactly why something matters legally because you told them
  • Law firms see you as a trusted advisor, not a vendor contact


Who you are

  • You have a legal background: Law degree or equivalent time working inside a law firm or legal department
  • You understand how decisions get made inside law firms and how to navigate that
  • You are equally comfortable in a client meeting and a product sync with engineers
  • You take ownership of outcomes, not just activities
  • You are structured, persistent, and know how to move a slow-moving institution forward
  • You communicate with precision. Lawyers and engineers both trust what you say

Bonus:

  • Experience in LegalTech, AI SaaS
  • Fluency in German, French, and English


Why join Omnilex

  • Own the rollout of a legal AI platform at the firms that will define how the industry adopts AI
  • Work directly with the engineers and fundamentally shape the product
  • Early-stage equity with meaningful upside and flexible work setup

json.title: Data Engineer - Business Intelligence & Analytics (d/w/m) 80 - 100%
json.descriptionHtml:
Stellenbeschreibung:

Wir setzen auf Menschen und auf die Kraft guter Teams. Zusammen treffen wir Entscheidungen, schaffen nachhaltige Lösungen und sichern den gemeinsamen Erfolg.

Das bewegst du
  • Du entwickelst, betreibst und optimierst Datenintegrationslösungen und stellst sicher, dass Unternehmensdaten zuverlässig, konsistent und für Analysen verfügbar sind.
  • Du modellierst Datenstrukturen für Reporting-, Analyse- und Self-Service-BI-Lösungen und entwickelst bestehende Datenmodelle gezielt weiter.
  • Du stellst die Qualität, Stabilität und Nachvollziehbarkeit von Datenflüssen, Schnittstellen und BI-Grundlagen sicher.
  • Du verstehst fachliche Anforderungen aus den operativen Einheiten und Fachbereichen, übersetzt diese in tragfähige Data-&-Analytics-Lösungen und arbeitest eng mit Business Data Analysten zusammen.
  • Du unterstützt Fachbereiche dabei, Daten im Tagesgeschäft besser zu nutzen, wirkst an der Weiterentwicklung und am Betrieb unserer Data-&-Analytics-Plattform in einer hybriden Microsoft-Umgebung mit und bringst dich aktiv bei technischen Verbesserungen ein.
Das bringst du mit
  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Weiterbildung in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich; Quereinsteiger mit relevanter Praxiserfahrung sind ebenfalls willkommen.
  • Berufserfahrung im Umfeld Data Engineering, Business Intelligence, Data Warehousing oder Analytics.
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Datenbanken, Datenmodellierung und Datenmanagement sowie Erfahrung mit Microsoft SQL Server, Power BI, T-SQL, SSIS, Tabular Models oder Microsoft Fabric von Vorteil.
  • Fähigkeit, fachliche Anforderungen zu verstehen und in technische Lösungen zu übersetzen.
  • Analytische Denkweise, strukturierte und selbstständige Arbeitsweise, Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Fachbereichen sowie sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse.
Dein Einsatzort

Was dich bei uns erwartet? Ein Arbeitsplatz, der sich deinem Leben anpasst. Unser Remote-Konzept ermöglicht dir flexibles Arbeiten in unserem modernen Büro im Herzen von Dübendorf oder direkt in unseren gastronomischen Betrieben und Hotels. Der Standort bietet dir beste ÖV-Anbindung, moderne Infrastruktur, ein hauseigenes Mitarbeiterrestaurant und kurze Entscheidungswege. Hier arbeitest du im Herzen der Organisation – mit direktem Draht zum Team und viel Raum für Eigenverantwortung.

Mit „The Way We Work“ schaffen wir bei SV Group eine Kultur der Zusammenarbeit, Offenheit und des Wachstums. Eigenverantwortung, konstruktives Feedback und klare Entscheidungen sichern unseren Erfolg. In deiner Rolle begleitest du das Team mit Hands-on-Mentalität, Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Vorwärtsdenken und Herzlichkeit – so entwickeln alle ihre Stärken weiter und wir schaffen gemeinsam unvergessliche Erlebnisse für unsere Gäste.

Das bieten wir dir - unter anderem

Schlemmen: Kostenlose, frische und gesunde Mitarbeitendenverpflegung
Vergünstigungen: Mitarbeitenden-Raten in den SV geführten Hotels und vergünstigtes Essen in unseren Restaurants
Entlohnung: Branchen- und marktgerechtes Salär und 13. Monatslohn
Flexibilität: Gleitzeitmodell, Remote Work, Teilzeitarbeit und Jobsharing möglich
Familienfreundlich: 5 Wochen Ferien, Kauf von zusätzlichen Ferien möglich, 16 Wochen Mutterschaftsurlaub
Prämie und Gutscheine: Mitarbeitende werben Mitarbeitende-Programm, Geschenke zu Jubiläum und Geburtstagen
Entwicklung: SV Academy mit knapp 300 Schulungen, Kursen, Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und E-Learnings
Weitere Benefits: Diverse Vergünstigungen (z.B. bei Sunrise, Reka, Migrol, Fleurop, Kollektivversicherung CSS/Helsana)

Ich freue mich auf deine Bewerbung

Sandro, HR Business Partner

json.title: Senior Data Modeler
json.descriptionHtml:
Employment Type: Permanent

Contract Duration

 Why you will love working here

At IATA, we represent over 350 airlines worldwide, striving to make aviation safer, smarter, more sustainable, and inclusive.

  • Our Values are not just words on a page - they are the energy behind everything we do: ONE IATA - We collaborate across teams, TRUSTED - We do the right thing, INNOVATIVE - We make tomorrow better, INCLUSIVE - We embrace diverse perspectives.
  • With over 30,000 courses available, we believe in continuous learning and support your growth in an ever-changing industry.
  • Diversity, equity, and inclusion are our priorities. We are certified by the Equal Salary Foundation, offering equal pay and family-friendly policies.
  • We encourage community involvement through volunteering and strive to make tomorrow better for aviation and our communities. We offer time off so you can support causes important to you.
  • We promote work-life balance with flexible work options, including remote and hybrid work, a generous 'work from abroad' policy, and you get your birthday off!

About The Team You Are Joining

Part of the Information and Data (I&D) Division, the Senior Data Architect & Data Modeler function is responsible for defining, maintaining, and evolving IATA’s data assets, standards, and practices across the organisation and with external industry stakeholders.

The team ensures consistency and interoperability between enterprise data models, industry standards, and implemented data solutions, supporting IATA’s ambition to make data accessible, trusted, and actionable across all business domains.

About The Role

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Data Architecture and Modelling, the Senior Data Architect & Data Modeler is responsible for designing and maintaining data models and end-to-end data solutions across enterprise, industry, and system landscapes.

The role covers enterprise data modelling, industry-aligned data structures, and contribution to data solution design, ensuring that data is consistently defined, structured, and implemented across platforms.

The role acts as a key bridge between business requirements, data architecture, and technical implementation, ensuring alignment between conceptual models and physical solutions, including data pipelines, integration layers, and AI-driven interaction models.

What Your Day Would Be Like

You will design and evolve data models and data solutions supporting operational systems, analytics platforms, data integration, and AI-enabled use cases.

You will collaborate with business stakeholders, architects, engineers, and external partners to ensure alignment between enterprise standards, industry models, and implemented solutions.

  • Design and maintain conceptual, logical, and physical data models across enterprise, industry, and solution domains
  • Translate business and industry requirements into scalable, standardised, and interoperable data structures
  • Define and support data pipelines, integration patterns, and data flows (ETL/ELT)
  • Ensure alignment between enterprise models, industry standards, and system implementations
  • Design and support AI-ready data structures, semantic layers, and data products for analytics and AI use cases
  • Define data structures and contracts supporting APIs, AI agents, and MCP-based data interaction models
  • Apply data modelling, governance, and quality standards across all solutions in collaboration with architects, engineers, and business teams.

We would love to hear from you if

  • 7+ years of experience in data modelling across enterprise and/or industry data domains
  • Strong expertise in conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling
  • Proven ability to translate business and industry requirements into standardised, scalable data solutions
  • Experience with data integration, pipelines, and ETL/ELT processes
  • Good understanding of data architecture and cloud data platforms (e.g. AWS, Snowflake)
  • Experience with APIs, data contracts, and AI/semantic layer concepts (e.g. MCP, agent-based interactions, or similar)
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Experience designing AI semantic layers, knowledge models, or data products for AI consumption
  • Exposure to MCP or comparable frameworks for AI orchestration and structured data interaction
  • Knowledge of data governance, metadata, and data quality practices
  • Experience with modelling tools (e.g. Sparx EA or similar)

Travel Required: 10-15

Learn more about IATA’s role in the industry, our benefits, and the team at iata/careers/ . We are looking forward to hearing from you!

json.title: Platform Engineer
json.descriptionHtml:
📍Location: Zurich

📅 Start Date: ASAP

⌛Employment: Full-time


🫧 About Bubble Robotics

At Bubble Robotics, we’re building the autonomous workforce for the ocean.

The 21st century will be decided offshore - from energy resilience and climate stability to national defense. Yet the ocean remains the least observed, least automated, and least understood environment on Earth.

Our constellation of small, resident robots lives at sea—inspecting offshore infrastructure, monitoring ecosystems, and securing critical assets continuously—without costly vessels or divers. They accelerate our understanding of the ocean and unlock the $3 trillion blue economy.

We’ve just closed a multi-million dollar pre-seed round, secured $5M+ in LOIs from top offshore energy operators, and are backed by leading VCs and ocean strategics. Our team includes alumni from NASA JPL, ETH Zurich and the world’s top robotics and climate labs.


🐋 The Role

We're looking for a Platform Engineer who thrives on building reliable backend and communication systems. If your background is in streaming/video transport, networking, industrial IoT, defense‑grade systems, real‑time communication platforms, or backend‑heavy SaaS, you’ll immediately recognize the challenges and impact of this role.

You’ll design and own the services that move live video, real‑time telemetry, and control signals between our edge devices and remote operators. This means building systems that stay responsive over unstable links, adapt to fluctuating bandwidth, and continue delivering mission‑critical data even when conditions are far from ideal.

Your work becomes the backbone of remote operation: resilient APIs, adaptive data pipelines, and a secure, performance‑focused network architecture that keeps operators connected, informed, and in control. If you enjoy building distributed systems that must work reliably under pressure — and you want your engineering to matter in the real world — we want you on this team.


Your Responsibilities
  • Back-end Architecture & API Ownership (70%)Design, implement, and maintain the core backend services that orchestrate robot control, telemetry, and supervision
  • Build robust APIs that serve as the foundation for teleoperation, monitoring, and future autonomy modules
  • Develop resilient data and video pipelines that adapt to unstable or low‑bandwidth connections
  • Ensure backend systems scale cleanly across multiple products, deployments, and operators
  • Network Architecture & Communication Systems (20%)Architect secure, low‑latency communication channels between field devices and the control center
  • Design network topologies that support multi‑stream video, telemetry, and command channels simultaneously
  • Implement secure tunneling (WireGuard, IPSec, etc.), NAT traversal strategies, and bandwidth‑adaptive routing
  • Ensure reliability under degraded or intermittent connectivity
  • DevOps & Operational Reliability (10%)Maintain CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows for backend and communication services
  • Implement observability: logging, metrics, alerting, and health monitoring across distributed systems
  • Contribute to infrastructure automation and container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, Nomad, etc.)


👀 What We're Looking For

Technical

  • 3+ years of experience in backend software engineering building production systems
  • Strong backend fundamentals — API design, distributed systems, data flow, reliability
  • Experience building systems that interact with hardware or edge devices (IoT, streaming, sensors, gateways, etc.)
  • Good engineering judgment around reliability, failure modes, degraded connectivity, and long‑term maintainability
  • API design for real‑time or device‑connected systems (telemetry, control, streaming, etc.)
  • Fluent in Python; solid experience with C++ or another systems language; JavaScript a plus
  • Hands‑on experience with Docker and containerized deployments
  • Strong understanding of server architecture — services, messaging, scaling, observability
  • Networking fundamentals — protocols, routing, NAT traversal, secure tunnels, bandwidth adaptation
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of open‑ended, cross‑disciplinary problems

Bonus

  • Experience with video or sensor data streaming
  • Exposure to teleoperation, real‑time communication systems, or autonomy pipelines
  • Experience with maritime, industrial, or remote‑operations environments

Languages

  • English mandatory
  • French and/or German a strong plus.


🐙How We Work
  • Small team, fast pace, high ownership.
  • We expect people to manage their work independently.
  • We communicate openly about problems and challenges.
  • We make pragmatic decisions and focus on execution.
  • Transparency matters more to us than optics.


🦾What We Offer
  • Build what no one else dares: persistent underwater autonomy by bringing spacetech to the ocean.
  • Join a world-class team with deep robotics and aerospace backgrounds.
  • Ship fast: From prototype to ocean in weeks, not years.
  • Equity and impact: Be part of a deep-tech company unlocking the $1T+ blue economy
  • Work on meaningful applications, from offshore wind to biodiversity monitoring and defense
  • Competitive salary and equity package
  • Small team, heavy ownership


Apply via our Notion Page. All applications are reviewed through the portal only; individual outreach can’t be responded to.

json.title: (Senior) Manager - AI & Business Transformation
json.descriptionHtml:
(Senior) Manager - AI & Business Transformation
 

Do you want to shape how AI and data transform the way organisations work? Are you ready to lead end-to-end AI and data solutions that change how clients deliver their services?

You will join a diverse, international team of AI, data, and subject matter specialists who work closely together, learn from each other, and bring ideas to market quickly. As a Senior Manager, you set the direction for engagements, take a leading role in client relationships, and help grow our AI and business transformation offering.

You work directly with senior stakeholders on AI and data strategies, define architectures and solution blueprints, and ensure solutions are robust, scalable, and adopted in practice.

Your Impact
  • Shape AI and data strategies with clients, defining vision, target architectures, and roadmaps for AI‑enabled business and workforce transformations, and translating strategic priorities into concrete programmes, offerings, and go‑to‑market initiatives.
  • Manage end‑to‑end AI, ML, and data solution design and delivery, from problem framing and discovery to production rollout and adoption, with a proven track record of moving use cases from prototype to production.
  • Architect and oversee implementation of modern data and AI platforms (e.g. cloud‑based data stacks, MLOps practices, integration with existing systems and processes), ensuring robust, scalable, and secure solutions.
  • Design and supervise development of AI and GenAI use cases, such as document intelligence, knowledge retrieval, workflow automation, risk and compliance models, and AI assistants for professionals, turning pilots and proofs of concept into scalable offerings and reusable assets.
  • Act as a thought leader and innovation driver: scan emerging AI technologies, identify new opportunities, and help build our market presence and pipeline through differentiated AI solutions.
  • Take a leading role in client conversations, workshops, and executive discussions, ensuring clear communication, strong stakeholder alignment, and trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders.
  • Lead multidisciplinary engagement teams, coach and mentor junior colleagues, and provide organisational and delivery leadership, including solution architecture governance, change enablement, and internal process excellence.
 

Your Skill Set
  • Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or a related technical field; additional business education (e.g. MBA, executive programmes) is a plus.
  • Extensive experience (typically 8+ years) in designing and delivering AI/ML and data solutions, including at least 3–4 years in management consulting, technology consulting, or a comparable client-facing advisory role; additional experience in product or complex enterprise environments is an advantage.
  • Deep hands-on expertise in machine learning and AI, including generative AI and large language models, plus solid experience in at least one of: document and knowledge management, legal or tax technology, risk and compliance analytics, or workflow automation.
  • Strong technical toolkit: proficiency in Python and common ML/AI frameworks; experience with modern data and ML platforms (e.g. Azure, AWS or GCP; Databricks; Snowflake; MLflow; vector databases; MLOps toolchains).
  • Proven experience leading multidisciplinary teams and complex projects, including solution architecture, delivery governance, stakeholder management, and change enablement.
  • Strong organisational and operational leadership skills, with the ability to drive structure, run essential internal processes, and ensure delivery excellence.
  • Excellent communication skills in German and English, with the ability to explain complex AI and data topics to both technical and non-technical audiences and to facilitate workshops, steering committees, and executive discussions.
 

Any questions? We are happy to help.
Joshua Albinus
Recruitment Team
+41 58 792 20 41
 

About PwC

At PwC Switzerland, we help clients build trust and reinvent so they can turn complexity into competitive advantage. We're part of a tech-forward, people-empowered network and help clients build, accelerate and sustain momentum across audit, assurance, tax, legal, workforce, deals and consulting.

json.title: Forward Deploy Engineer
json.descriptionHtml:
Senior Palantir Foundry Engineer - Boutique AI/Data Consultancy

Remote-first (occasional Switzerland travel)

The consultancy

A specialist Foundry & AIP consultancy built by people who've actually shipped on the platform - the founding team came up through Palantir itself. Small, senior, and focused: they solve hard operational problems for clients using Foundry rather than generic data tooling, and they move fast doing it.

Why this role exists

They need someone who can own delivery end to end - not a pipeline builder who hands off to someone else for the client conversation, and not a client-facing consultant who leans on others for the technical build. Both, in one person.

You'd be running strategic client engagements: designing the Foundry workflow, building it, and sitting across the table from the CxOs and product leads who need to trust the outcome. You'd also have real input into how the team delivers - this isn't a role where process gets handed to you, it's one where you help write it.

What the work actually looks like

  • Designing and building Foundry workflows end to end - from raw data integration through to tools people actually make decisions with
  • Running client relationships directly, across seniority levels, from technical data teams up to CxOs
  • Taking ownership of high-visibility engagements from kickoff to delivery, including leading other engineers on them
  • Feeding into how the consultancy operates - delivery approach, engineering standards, where the business goes next

What you'll need

  • Solid engineering foundation - Python, Spark, TypeScript
  • Real depth in Foundry and/or Databricks, ideally both, including how data modelling and ontologies actually work in practice, not just in theory
  • Comfort leading engineers through complex, sometimes ambiguous client environments
  • The ability to switch registers - technical enough for a data team, commercial enough for a CxO, often in the same day
  • A genuinely independent working style - no one's checking in on you daily

On experience: they'd rather see two years touching a wide range of Foundry use cases - data connection through to ontology-driven applications - than five years of narrow pipeline work in one place. Range beats tenure here.

Setup

Remote-first. Some travel expected for team gatherings in Switzerland and time on client sites.

json.descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Founded in 2017, Unit8 is a fast-growing European AI and data analytics consulting and services company dedicated to solving complex problems of traditional industries like automotive, chemical, financial services, manufacturing and pharma. We work with some of the biggest organisations in Europe to solve the challenges that directly affect their business - be it operations, finance, manufacturing or R&D. Since our foundation, we have successfully delivered more than 350 projects and have grown to 170+ talented individuals across 9 office locations in Germany, Switzerland, Poland, Spain, US, and Middle East.


Our misssion

Unit8's mission is to drive the adoption of AI and Data Science in the non-digital industries and to help accelerate their digital transformation. Among its activities, Unit8 dedicates a part of its resources and time to projects that deeply matter to us, which includes collaboration on pro-bono and "engineering for good" causes.


Are You the team member we are looking for?

Unit8 is looking for a Senior Consultant to join our growing Data & AI Consulting Practice in Zurich. Purpose of our Practice is to support our data scientists and data engineers with a holistic data & AI related consulting offering, ranging from technical/ operational to conceptual/ strategic. You will have the opportunity to accompany the implementation of state-of-the-art ML models and data science technologies in real-world, highly impactful challenges. You will drive the the whole lifecycle from business development to project implementation and client relationship building. You will become a core team member and take responsibility for scaling up the consulting practice within a fast-growing AI & Advanced Analytics services provider.


What You'll Do

Your role can evolve and will depend on our clients' and internal challenges.

In general, you will:

  • consult our clients on their path to become a data-driven company, e.g. by assessing the client's data and machine learning maturity or identifying data-driven use cases and a defining an impactful implementation roadmap
  • interact with our clients to understand their data-related challenges and related tech and business questions they need to answer
  • collaborate with our data scientists, data engineers and IT architects on the implementation of impactful data-based solutions and machine learning use cases
  • consult on the implementation of critical enablers like data governance, model governance, MLOps or analytics centres of excellence
  • interact directly with the head of our Data & AI Consulting practice as part of a small, high-performing team to co-develop the growth strategy and concepts for new data & AI consulting offerings
  • contribute to our business development in preparing and participating in industry conferences, workshops and client sales meetings
  • support the creation of white papers and industry thought leadership on data science & AI-related topics


You are

  • equipped with 5-10 years of work experience in a leading management consultancy at the intersection of business & technology or an equivalent experience in a corporate environment
  • experienced in advising clients on data-based topics such as (advanced) analytics, machine learning, data platforms and cloud
  • able to quickly identify and prioritise business challenges and provide innovative and relevant solutions, either during an ongoing client project or in business development activities
  • talented in building lasting relationships to clients and team members
  • a Bachelor's or Master's graduate in IT/ computer science, engineering, business, mathematics or natural sciences
  • fluent in English and German.


What We Offer

  • Opportunity to contribute to the growth of one of the leading Swiss data & AI consultancies
  • Work on cutting-edge data & AI topics
  • Option to partially work from home
  • Flexible working hours
  • Cross-office/ company-wide frequent events like off-sites
  • Dedicated budget for training


Why Unit8?

At Unit8, we don't just turn data into value - we empower the people who make it possible. If you are looking for a place where you can take ownership, your next chapter starts here.

  • Trust from Day One: We rely on your expertise. Trust is the core of our culture
  • Meaningful Work: You drive things that matter and make others' projects easier through your work
  • Passion-Led Projects: We provide the environment where you can pursue your passion alongside top talent. If you are excited about the future, you belong with us


Please submit your application materials exclusively in English.

We welcome people from all backgrounds, regardless of gender, personality, national origin, race, religion, skin color, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, disability, or veteran status.

json.title: Senior Compiler Engineer
json.descriptionHtml:
We are looking to hire a CPU Compiler Engineer for an exciting and fun role at NVIDIA. We craft outstanding compilers that realise the potential of NVIDIA's CPUs designed for the world's largest AI and HPC workloads: https://www.nvidia.com/en-in/data-center/grace-cpu/. Our compiler organisation makes its mark on every CPU, GPU, DPU and SoC product that NVIDIA builds. Would you like to be part of this outstanding organisation?

We need you to design, develop and help improve the upstream GNU Toolchain for NVIDIA's CPUs. These compilers are key for the performance of AI, HPC and other performance critical software deployed on NVIDIA Data Centres, on the cloud and at super computing centres around the world. In this role you will solve critical problems working alongside an outstanding engineering team with vision in Compiler technology and systems software, doing what you enjoy! You will also be collaborating with the relevant upstream projects and improving the state of the art If this sounds like a fun challenge, we would be delighted to hear from you!!

What You Will Be Doing

  • Work with a geographically distributed partner organisation to understand, modify and improve CPU Compiler SW at NVIDIA.
  • Contribute new features and optimisation techniques targeting NVIDIA Grace CPUs engaging with upstream and open source communities.
  • Develop compiler SW that is optimised for performance.
  • Be part of a team that is at the centre of AI, HPC and data centre technologies.
  • Help in the development of next generation CPU micro-architecture.

What We Need To See

  • BS or MS degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field or equivalent experience
  • More than 12 years of experience with compiler development in a production environment.
  • Knowledge of Language Front-Ends or Compiler optimisation techniques and code generation modules.
  • Strong hands-on C++ programming skills
  • Excellent verbal and written communications skills

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

  • Familiarity with CPU architectures such as Arm Architecture (AArch32, AArch64), RISC-V, x86_64, PowerPC or DSPs and engaging with pre-silicon compiler and toolchain contributions.
  • A track record of working with industry standard compiler infrastructure such as GNU Toolchain and familiarity with LLVM
  • Knowledge of AI algorithms, scientific HPC applications and related code optimisations.
  • Meaningful contributions to free software and open source compiler communities.

With highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most innovative and talented people on the planet working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our world-class engineering teams are expanding fast. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a genuine passion for technology, we want to hear from you.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

json.title: Senior Java Engineer - Focus: Agentic AI
json.descriptionHtml:
Wir sind ELCA, einer der grössten Schweizer IT-Stämme mit über 2'300 Experten. Wir sind multikulturell und haben Niederlassungen in der Schweiz, Spanien, Frankreich, Vietnam und Mauritius. 
Bei ELCA ist Agentic Engineering kein Konzept für die Zukunft, sondern gelebter Alltag. Wir setzen KI-Agenten bereits über die gesamte Projektwertschöpfung ein: von der Offerte über Business-Analyse und Umsetzung bis zum Hypercare. Als Senior Agentic Engineer entwirfst, implementierst und betreibst Agenten in laufenden Kundenprojekten und prägst Best Practices und Methodik aktiv mit.

  • Du übernimmst die Rolle des ‚Human Supervisor' in Agentic-Projekten und steuerst, reviewst und validierst den Output von KI-Agenten nach ELCA Qualitätsstandards
  • Du setzt AI-Entwicklungswerkzeuge (wie Claude Code, GitHub Copilot und ELCAi-Method) zielgerichtet ein und steigerst damit Produktivität und Codequalität in Enterprise-Projekten
  • Du entwirfst und pflegst Agentic-Architekturen und System-Prompt-Strukturen für multi-agent Workflows entlang der gesamten Entwicklungskette (Analyst bis QA)
  • Du entwickelst in enger Zusammenarbeit mit AI-Agenten stabile, performante Java/Angular Lösungen und sicherst dabei ELCA Coding Guidelines und CI/CD-Standards
  • Du coachst und befähigst weniger erfahrene Kolleg:innen im Einstieg in Agentic Engineering und hilfst dabei, das Knowhow im Team zu verankern und weiterzuentwickeln
  • Du trägst aktiv zur Weiterentwicklung der ELCAi-Method und der internen Agentic Engineering Best Practices bei
  • Mit Deiner Expertise unterstützt Du bei der Akquisition neuer Agentic-Projekte und überzeugst Kunden von der Leistungsfähigkeit unseres Ansatzes

Unser Angebot

  • Ein dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld an der Spitze der Softwareentwicklung: Du arbeitest mit modernsten AI-Werkzeugen an realen Enterprise Projekten für namhafte Schweizer Kunden
  • Vielfältige Möglichkeiten, Dein Wissen in Agentic Engineering, AI-Architektur und Delivery-Methodik kontinuierlich auszubauen
  • Attraktive Perspektiven für Karriere und persönliche Entwicklung durch Training, Coaching und Konferenzen (z. B. Voxxed, JAX, BATbern)
  • Eine flache Hierarchie und eine Kultur der Zusammenarbeit über alle Disziplinen hinweg
  • Die Chance, durch den Aufbau grossartiger Software etwas im Leben der Menschen zu verändern
  • Work-Life-Balance (41 Std./W in Gleitzeit, Möglichkeit für Homeoffice, mind. 25 Ferientage), ergonomischer und flexibler Arbeitsplatz in einem multikulturellen Umfeld
  • Interessante Benefits wie z. B.: Beitrag an bestehendes Mobiltelefon oder Business Handy, 1/2-Tax Abonnement und geschäftlich unterwegs im Zug mit 1. Klasse, attraktive Pensionskassenmodelle, Übernahme der NBU (privat, weltweit), fortschrittliche Krankentaggeldversicherung sowie Flottenrabatt

Dein Profil

  • Abgeschlosses Studium (UNI/ETH/FH) in Informatik oder verwandter Fachrichtung
  • 5+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Entwicklung moderner Java-Anwendungen (Spring Boot, JPA/Hibernate, Angular oder vergleichbar) mit dem Anspruch Architekturentscheide zu verantworten und nicht nur umzusetzen
  • Nachgewiesene praktische Erfahrung mit AI-gestützter Entwicklung (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot oder vergleichbare Werkzeuge) in realen Projekten
  • Du bewertest AI-generierten Output mit deiner technischen Expertise: Du nutzt Stärken der Agenten, erkennst aber auch Limitationen und setzt Qualitätsstandards durch
  • Erfahrung im Mentoring und in der Förderung von Teammitgliedern
  • Fliessend in Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift
  • Kenntnisse in BMAD-Method, SpecKit oder strukturierten Agentic Engineering Frameworks sind ein grosses Plus und ein Zeichen, dass wir eine passende Umgebung für Dich haben 

Wir setzen auf gesunde Werte und sind davon überzeugt, dass Diversität der Schlüssel zum Erfolg ist. Wer Herausforderungen mit Neugierde, Motivation und Tatendrang angeht, ist bei uns genau richtig! Lass Dich von unserem Leitsatz inspirieren: We make it work!

json.title: Principal Software/Data Engineer
json.descriptionHtml:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

This role is based in the Innovation Accelerator (IA) team, the innovation engine and connective tissue for Design, Data and Data Science innovation strategy within Product Development Data Sciences (PDD). We translate our long-term PDD vision into actionable strategy, shaping and prioritizing innovative cross-functional use cases that span PDD, PD, and Pharma. As both integrators and incubators, we explore, prototype, and help productize solutions to deliver impact in close partnership with internal Roche teams and external collaborators. With a mindset rooted in openness, value creation, and adaptability, we navigate the innovation ecosystem to drive transformative impact and future readiness across the organization.

The Opportunity

  • You design and implement robust, secure, and scalable software architectures that support data- and ML-driven products
  • You build front-end interfaces using modern frameworks (e.g., React, Vue) to enable intuitive user interactions with complex data outputs
  • You develop and maintain back-end APIs and data pipelines that integrate models and data into production-grade environments
  • You write simple, elegant, well-structured, and well-tested applications, software, and/or code that drive new features and improvements across all our products and services in adherence with regulatory compliance
  • You collaborate with UX designers, data scientists, and product managers to align on user needs and translate them into technical solutions
  • You monitor and optimize the performance, reliability, and maintainability of deployed software systems
  • You enable reproducibility and development efficiency by implementing standardized logging, version control, and configuration management, while contributing to internal knowledge sharing and reusable code libraries
  • You partner with IT teams to manage CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and security protocols
  • You participate in agile ceremonies (e.g., sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives) and contribute to backlog refinement and prioritization
  • You apply a product-thinking mindset to balance technical trade-offs with user impact and business value
  • You develop tools and dashboards for monitoring data flows, system health, and model performance
  • You keep up to date with emerging technologies in software, cloud, and data engineering to continuously improve practices
  • You support early pilots, MVPs, and scaled implementations across therapeutic areas by ensuring smooth deployment of experiments and applications in cloud and custom PaaS environments
  • You embrace a collaborative culture of continuous learning, experimentation, and feedback

Who you are:

  • You have a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field
  • You have a minimum of 8 years of experience in software engineering, including leading architecture or infrastructure efforts for data-centric or ML-powered applications; or an advanced degree with 6 years of equivalent work experience
  • You have 4+ years of experience with relational and non-relational database systems (e.g., PostgreSQL, Redshift, MongoDB, S3)
  • You have 4+ years of experience building and optimizing data pipelines using tools such as DVC, Pandas, Airflow
  • You have strong proficiency in front-end frameworks (e.g., React, Angular) and back-end API development
  • You have hands-on experience with cloud services (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform)
  • You have strong experience managing CI/CD workflows, version control, and security protocols in production environments
  • You have proven ability to lead technically complex initiatives and balance long-term architecture with near-term delivery
  • You have capacity for independent thinking and ability to make decisions based upon sound principles
  • You exhibit excellent strategic agility including problem-solving and critical thinking skills, and agility that extends beyond technical domain
  • You demonstrate respect for cultural differences when interacting with colleagues in the global workplace
  • You possess excellent verbal and written communication skills, specifically in the areas of presentation and writing, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts in clear language

Preferred:

  • Experience in pharmaceutical, healthcare, or regulated industries
  • Deep familiarity with cloud-native development using AWS
  • Knowledge of privacy and compliance frameworks (e.g., HIPAA, GxP)
  • Experience with containerization/orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Exposure to data visualization tools such as Dash, Streamlit, or Power BI
  • Understanding of the clinical development lifecycle and scientific workflows
  • Demonstrated mentoring and technical leadership within agile teams
  • High degree of strategic agility and problem-solving; capable of navigating complexity with precision

Relocation benefits are not available for this posting

#PDDT

#PDDBasel

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

json.title: Functional Application Manager AI (w/m/d) 100%
json.descriptionHtml:
BMS Building Materials Suisse ist ein Grosshändler für Baumaterial im Rohbau und Innenausbau. Zu unserer Unternehmensgruppe gehören die namhaften Spezialisten Baubedarf, Richner, Gétaz Miauton und RegusciReco. Unsere erfahrenen Fachleute beraten, unterstützen und inspirieren mit grossem Engagement Kunden aus der Bauwirtschaft sowie Privatkunden an rund 110 Standorten in der ganzen Schweiz. Nahe am Baualltag sind wir der lokale und verlässliche Partner für jedes Bauprojekt. Schnell, einfach und kompetent.

Du möchtest nicht nur bestehende Systeme betreuen, sondern mit den Möglichkeiten von Künstlicher Intelligenz unsere Kernapplikationen weiterentwickeln? Dann bewirb dich jetzt bei uns und gestalte die Zukunft mit!

Für unser Team am Standort Buchs (AG) oder St. Légier (VD) suchen per 1. September 2026 oder nach Vereinbarung einen kreativen und ambitionierten AI Application Manager, der unsere digitalen Prozesse auf das nächste Level bringt.

Functional Application Manager AI (w/m/d) 100%

Aufgabengebiet

  • Du stellst den reibungslosen Betrieb unserer Kernapplikationen sicher, koordinierst Updates und entwickelst diese durch den gezielten Einsatz von AI-Lösungen kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Du leitest und koordinierst Projekte zur Integration von AI Agents in bestehende Geschäftsprozesse und treibst die intelligente Automatisierung von Abläufen voran.
  • Du betreust und implementierst Lösungen im Bereich Microsoft SharePoint und Power Automate.
  • Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen Fachbereichen und technischen Partnern, übersetzt Anforderungen in technische Spezifikationen und entwickelst gemeinsam praxistaugliche Lösungen.
  • Du stellst die Einhaltung von Datenschutz-, Sicherheits- und Compliance-Vorgaben sicher – insbesondere im Zusammenhang mit dem Einsatz von AI-Services und LLM-APIs.

Profil

Wenn dein Herz beim oben beschriebenen Aufgabengebiet höherschlägt und du die folgenden Kompetenzen mitbringst, bist du unser*e Wunschkandidat*in:

  • Du verfügst über mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung im Application Management, Technical Product Management oder in einer vergleichbaren Funktion und hast IT-Implementierungsprojekte erfolgreich geleitet oder begleitet.
  • Du hast bereits praktische Erfahrungen mit generativen AI-Technologien gesammelt und kennst dich mit aktuellen Entwicklungen rund um LLMs und AI Agents aus. Erfahrungen mit Tools und Frameworks wie Claude, MCP-Server oder vergleichbaren Technologien sind von Vorteil.
  • Du musst kein Senior Developer sein, nutzt aber moderne AI-Entwicklungstools wie Cursor oder GitHub Copilot, um Ideen schnell zu validieren und erste Prototypen umzusetzen.
  • Du bringst Erfahrung mit SharePoint mit und kennst dich mit dessen Konfiguration und Verwaltung aus. Kenntnisse in Dynamics 365, insbesondere Business Central, sind von Vorteil.
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse. Weitere Sprachkenntnisse in Englisch, Französisch oder Italienisch sind von Vorteil.
  • Du analysierst komplexe Prozesse, erkennst Optimierungspotenziale und identifizierst Einsatzmöglichkeiten, bei denen AI einen echten Mehrwert schaffen kann.
  • Du vermittelst technische Themen verständlich, arbeitest eng mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern zusammen und begeisterst Anwender*innen für neue Technologien.

Wir bieten

  • eine herausfordernde, vielseitige und interessante Tätigkeit in einem guten Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Wert auf aktive Zusammenarbeit und gleichzeitig Selbständigkeit gelegt wird
  • eine intensive Einarbeitung ist Programm, wobei unsere neuen Kollegen von Produkt- und Systemschulungen innerhalb der Firma profitieren können
  • Unterstützung unserer Mitarbeitenden in ihrer fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung
  • Homeoffice nach Reglement und Absprache möglich
  • 5 Wochen Ferien (6 Wochen ab 50. Altersjahr) und Ferieneinkauf bis max. 10 Tagen, Zusatzleistungen wie eine hervorragend finanzierte eigenständige Pensionskasse und Vergünstigungen auf unser komplettes Produktesortiment sowie externe Prämienvorteile

Wir freuen uns auf deine vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen in elektronischer Form.

Willst du mehr über uns erfahren? Besuche jetzt unsere Karriere-Seite unter jobs.bmsuisse.ch.

Gerne beantworten wir deine Fragen zur Stelle unter jobs@bmsuisse.ch.

Aus Datenschutzgründen werden Initiativbewerbungen sowie eBewerbungen via Email und/oder Postversand nicht weiter berücksichtigt.

json.title: Java Software Engineer - AI & Cloud Solutions (m/w/d)
json.descriptionHtml:
Lohn - CHF115'000 - 135'000

Massgeschneiderte Digitalisierung und innovative IT-Lösungen – unser Rocken Partner zählt zu den führenden Anbietern in der Schweizer IT-Branche. Das Unternehmen verbindet technologisches Know-how mit strategischer Beratung und begleitet Kunden auf dem Weg in die digitale Zukunft. Von komplexen Systemarchitekturen über Cloud-Lösungen bis hin zu massgeschneiderter Softwareentwicklung: Hier entstehen Lösungen, die wirklich bewegen. Der Fokus liegt auf langfristigen Partnerschaften und nachhaltigen Projekten, die echten Mehrwert schaffen. Technologie wird nicht um ihrer selbst willen eingesetzt, sondern immer mit Blick auf den konkreten Nutzen. Das Team arbeitet agil, interdisziplinär und auf Augenhöhe – Eigenverantwortung und fachlicher Austausch werden aktiv gelebt. Flache Hierarchien und ein respektvoller Umgang prägen den Arbeitsalltag. Wenn du an der Schnittstelle zwischen Technologie und Business gestalten möchtest, ist unser Rocken Partner genau die richtige Adresse. Bereit für den nächsten Schritt?

Rolle

In dieser Rolle gestaltest du als erfahrener Java-Softwareentwicklerin anspruchsvolle, nachhaltige Softwarelösungen und prägst so die digitale Transformation in vielfältigen Projekten. Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für Design, Entwicklung und Pflege komplexer Java-Anwendungen und stellst hohe Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards sicher. Dabei setzt du gezielt AI-gestützte Tools ein, um Entwicklungszyklen zu verkürzen, Qualität zu steigern und innovative Lösungsansätze schneller zu evaluieren. Du treibst den Aufbau agentenbasierter Entwicklung aktiv mit voran und gestaltest so die nächste Generation von Software Engineering. Durch deine technische Exzellenz und dein konzeptionelles Denken übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle in der Weiterentwicklung moderner, zukunftsfähiger Lösungen.

Verantwortung

  • Komplexe Java-Lösungen für anspruchsvolle Kundenprojekte konzipierst und realisierst Du mit hoher Eigenverantwortung
  • Die enge Zusammenarbeit mit interdisziplinären Teams ermöglicht es Dir, technische Anforderungen mit fachlichen Bedürfnissen optimal zu verbinden
  • Moderne AI-gestützte Entwicklungsmethoden nutzt Du gezielt und trägst aktiv zur Weiterentwicklung unserer Software-Engineering-Standards bei
  • Als erfahrene Fachperson übernimmst Du eine Schlüsselrolle, unterstützt weniger erfahrene Kolleginnen und Kollegen und förderst den Know-how-Transfer
  • Deine Expertise bringst Du zudem bei Kundenworkshops und Presales-Aktivitäten professionell ein

Qualifikationen

  • Studium der Informatik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung (Uni/ETH/FH) sowie mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in Java (Core, Spring Ecosystem, JPA/Hibernate)
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Spring, Spring Boot, Microservices, RESTful APIs (OpenAPI/Swagger) sowie Grundlagen in SOAP werden vorausgesetzt
  • Erfahrung mit Oracle, MSSQL, PostgreSQL, SQL, CI/CD-Pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift und idealerweise AWS ist vorhanden
  • Kenntnisse in AI, AI-gestützter Softwareentwicklung, Agentic Engineering, Angular/React/Vue sowie Erfahrung im Mentoring von Junior-Entwicklern sind von Vorteil
  • Deutsch schriftlich sowie mündlich einwandfrei

Benefits

  • Interessante und abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeiten/Projekte
  • Internationales Umfeld
  • Eingespieltes und dynamisches Team
  • Attraktive Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
  • Flache Hierarchien

json.title: Founding Engineer – SF Hackerhouse (Visa sponsored; $3M pre-seed)
json.descriptionHtml:
We’re a German founding team that just raised a $3M pre-seed round from top-tier investors and we’re now looking for a Founding Engineer from the DACH region to join us in our San Francisco Hackerhouse. We’ll fly you out, cover your visa sponsorship, and bring you directly into the center of the action.

This is a once in a lifetime opportunity for the most ambitious engineers in DACH to build alongside us in SF and shape the future of AI recruiting.

About Clera:

Clera is a fast-growing AI start-up reimagining how top talent finds their dream jobs. We’re already working with leading, VC-backed startups such as Mintlify, Luminai, and Windsurf - many in AI, all VC-backed. We believe recruitment needs to be talent-first to make it easy to get in touch with those companies, be coached in the journey and actually get hired. We just raised our big pre-seed and are now growing as quickly as possible.

Thousands of talents engage with Clera every week. We’ve connected many of them with companies where they’ve landed exciting new roles. With the traditional $600B headhunting industry ripe for AI-driven disruption, we are aiming to build a massive company, providing better outcomes for talents and companies. We’re at a pivotal moment—right before liftoff. Early enough that you’ll get meaningful ownership. Far enough that we’ve got a product, paying customers, and a team of A-players.

The Role:

  • Automating the work of headhunters is a massive tech challenge - and opportunity. We are looking for an exceptional founding engineer.
  • You will work directly with our CTO & Co-Founder Daniel and our engineers and ship your own features to production every day. You will have a strong impact on building our fully agentic system to automate the headhunting process end-to-end.

Your Experience:

  • Very strong software engineering background: Experience in TypeScript and React
  • Strong practical experience working with AI: We work 24/7 in Cursor - ideally you have experience coding with AI. Bonus if you have an experience working with LLM APIs
  • Startup mindset - high agency, resourceful, and obsessed with creating value

Who You Are:

  • Take full ownership of projects, from concept to deployment and do whatever it takes to get the job done.
  • Write code fast and scrap it even faster, but know when to transition to building for scale and quality.
  • Enjoy talking to customers and iterating based on feedback.
  • Are willing to work hard, to create something new with a lot of impact, changing how millions of talents find their jobs in the future.

Tech stack: TypeScript, React, Cursor, Supabase, Prisma, Typesense, LLM APIs, Trigger.dev

Working in hacker-house in SF:

  • Live & build with a small founding team
  • Zero commute, 10× feedback loops & team bonding
  • Our international team flew in from Germany, US, Sweden, France
  • Very intense but also extremely productive & fun to live and work from the same AirBnb as a team
  • We can support with visa processes

Perks:

  • Experienced founders and a team of A Players
  • True ownership, no micromanagement, shipping to production every day
  • Work on some of the most technically challenging projects as we scale our marketplace

json.title: MLOps Lead
json.descriptionHtml:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a MLOps Lead based in Switzerland.

As an MLOps Lead, you will shape the strategy, architecture, and operational excellence of a cutting-edge machine learning infrastructure supporting large-scale AI systems. Leading a team of MLOps engineers, you will bridge the gap between research and production, ensuring that machine learning models are deployed, monitored, and scaled efficiently in high-performance environments. This role combines technical leadership with hands-on architectural decision-making, offering the opportunity to build robust infrastructure from the ground up while collaborating closely with engineering, research, and product teams. Working in a fully remote, international environment, you will help establish best practices and drive innovation across the entire machine learning lifecycle, enabling the delivery of reliable and scalable AI solutions.

Accountabilities

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of MLOps engineers while fostering a culture of collaboration, technical excellence, and continuous improvement.
  • Define and execute the MLOps roadmap, aligning infrastructure initiatives with research, engineering, and product objectives.
  • Design, implement, and maintain scalable machine learning infrastructure, including automated training pipelines, CI/CD workflows, orchestration frameworks, and deployment processes.
  • Drive architectural decisions for model serving platforms, ensuring low-latency, high-throughput inference using modern serving technologies.
  • Build and optimize feature stores, data pipelines, and storage solutions that support large-scale model training and production inference.
  • Collaborate closely with research teams to streamline the transition of machine learning models from experimentation to production environments.
  • Establish monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability strategies to ensure model performance, system reliability, and early detection of drift or operational issues.
  • Define engineering standards, operational best practices, and scalable infrastructure processes that support long-term platform growth.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in MLOps or machine learning infrastructure engineering, including at least 3 years in a technical leadership role.
  • Strong software engineering expertise in Python, with working knowledge of Bash and/or Go.
  • Proven experience building, scaling, and leading MLOps infrastructure from the ground up.
  • Deep knowledge of machine learning platforms and frameworks such as MLflow, Weights & Biases (W&B), PyTorch, and TensorFlow.
  • Extensive experience with model serving technologies including Triton Inference Server, TorchServe, TensorFlow Serving, or KServe.

json.title: Full-Stack Robotics Software Engineer
json.descriptionHtml:
📍Location: Zurich

📅 Start Date: ASAP

⌛Employment: Full-time


🫧 About Bubble Robotics

At Bubble Robotics, we’re building the autonomous workforce for the ocean.

The 21st century will be decided offshore - from energy resilience and climate stability to national defense. Yet the ocean remains the least observed, least automated, and least understood environment on Earth.

Our constellation of small, resident robots lives at sea—inspecting offshore infrastructure, monitoring ecosystems, and securing critical assets continuously—without costly vessels or divers. They accelerate our understanding of the ocean and unlock the $3 trillion blue economy.

We’ve just closed a multi-million dollar pre-seed round, secured $5M+ in LOIs from top offshore energy operators, and are backed by leading VCs and ocean strategics. Our team includes alumni from NASA JPL, ETH Zurich and the world’s top robotics and climate labs.


🐋 The Role

We're looking for a Back End / Robotics Software Engineer to own the software backbone of our marine surface robotics platform. You will lead the API design and back end architecture that everything else depends on — data pipelines, video streaming, teleoperation infrastructure, and the core systems that make our robots operable in real-world conditions. The focus is robust engineering that works reliably under degraded connectivity and at sea, not research prototypes.

  • Own and lead the back end architecture and API layer across all robot control and supervision systems
  • Design and maintain reliable data and video pipelines for unstable or variable connections
  • Build the communication infrastructure supporting teleoperation, monitoring, and future autonomy modules
  • Define and maintain the software foundation as it scales across future products and deployments


👀 What We're Looking For

Technical

  • 3+ years of experience in back-end software engineering
  • Experience working on real robotic hardware in a real engineering environment, not purely research
  • Strong back-end fundamentals, potentially with full-stack breadth
  • Good judgment around reliability, failure handling, and long-term maintainability
  • API design for robotics or hardware connected devices
  • Fluent in Python and C++ — JavaScript a strong plus
  • Strong previous usage of Docker and containerization
  • Strong experience with server architecture and deployment
  • Knowledge of networking fundamentals — protocols, connectivity under degraded conditions, security
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of an open-ended problem.

Bonus

  • Experience with video or sensor streaming
  • Exposure to teleoperation systems, autonomy, simulation
  • Previous work in maritime robotics

Languages

  • English mandatory. French and/or German a strong plus.


🐙How We Work
  • Small team, fast pace, high ownership.
  • We expect people to manage their work independently.
  • We communicate openly about problems and challenges.
  • We make pragmatic decisions and focus on execution.
  • Transparency matters more to us than optics.


🦾What We Offer
  • Build what no one else dares: persistent underwater autonomy by bringing spacetech to the ocean.
  • Join a world-class team with deep robotics and aerospace backgrounds.
  • Ship fast: From prototype to ocean in weeks, not years.
  • Equity and impact: Be part of a deep-tech company unlocking the $1T+ blue economy
  • Work on meaningful applications, from offshore wind to biodiversity monitoring and defense
  • Competitive salary and equity package
  • Small team, heavy ownership


Apply via our Notion Page. All applications are reviewed through the portal only; individual outreach can’t be responded to.

json.title: Lead AI Scientist – Industrial AI
json.descriptionHtml:
About Ucentrics:

Ucentrics AG is a deep-tech startup and ETH Zurich spin-off building AI- and AR-powered solutions for frontline workers in complex industrial environments.


Our mission is to capture organizational knowledge and expertise and transform it into scalable digital guidance, intelligent task verification, and automated documentation across mobile devices and AR wearables.


The Role

We are looking for a Lead AI Scientist to lead the development of our agentic AI systems that understand industrial processes by reasoning across workflows, documents, reports, videos, and connected tools. These systems will transform expert and organizational knowledge into digital user guidance, enable real-time visual task verification, and automate process documentation.


You will take ownership of these AI capabilities from research and prototyping through to production. Working closely with our CTO and our software engineering, AR/mobile, and product teams, you will turn advances in computer vision, foundation models, VLMs, and LLMs into reliable and scalable product capabilities.


This role requires strong technical depth, curiosity, and a pragmatic approach to turning ambitious research ideas into products that create measurable value in real-world environments.


Key Responsibilities

  • Define the technical direction of our AI capabilities and lead their development from research to production
  • Develop computer vision and machine learning models for industrial process understanding and real-time task verification
  • Build multimodal AI systems that extract and structure operational knowledge from videos, documents, reports, and workflow data
  • Establish evaluation methods for model accuracy, robustness, reliability, and product impact
  • Collaborate closely with engineering and product teams to integrate AI capabilities into scalable production systems



Qualifications

  • PhD in computer vision, machine learning, artificial intelligence, or a closely related field (outstanding non-PhD applicants are also welcome to apply)
  • Strong hands-on experience in computer vision and machine learning, such as object detection, classification, 3D registration pipelines
  • Practical experience with transformers, foundation models, VLMs, LLMs, MCP, and agentic AI pipelines
  • Proficiency in Python and PyTorch, Tensorflow
  • Experience with Cloud services such as Azure and google cloud
  • Ability to formulate complex research and product problems, evaluate solutions rigorously, and translate results into working systems
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate closely with engineering, product, and leadership teams
  • Experience deploying and operating AI systems in production is a strong advantage
  • Proficient in English; German is an advantage



What We Value

We are looking for someone we can build with. You combine technical ambition with sound judgment, take ownership of difficult problems, and communicate your ideas clearly.

We value rigor, pragmatic experimentation, reliability, trust, and the ability to move comfortably between research questions, product requirements, and engineering constraints.


Why Join Ucentrics?

  • Work on challenging multimodal AI problems grounded in real industrial processes
  • Collaborate with an interdisciplinary team across AI, software engineering, and product development
  • Take significant ownership in a fast-moving environment with short decision paths
  • Receive a competitive salary and the opportunity to participate in the company’s equity program



Apply Now

If you are excited about building AI systems that capture, understand, and scale operational expertise, we would be delighted to hear from you.

json.title: Software Engineering Manager
json.descriptionHtml:
We are expanding Duferco’s Corporate Innovation Team: a fast-moving engineering team operating in a start up-like environment, backed by the stability and scale of a diversified global group.

We are looking for an engineering leader whose mission is to help evolve how software is built inside the organization through AI-assisted development, agentic coding workflows, and modern engineering practices.

This is not a traditional engineering management role focused mainly on delivery coordination. We are looking for someone who can establish and enforce high-leverage development workflows, improve engineering effectiveness, and help teams fully exploit modern AI coding tools and autonomous development systems.

You will work closely with engineers across projects and domains — helping shape coding standards, review processes, engineering tooling, development workflows, and AI-native software delivery practices.

About the Team

We sit close to real business problems and have the freedom to prototype and ship quickly. AI is already part of our daily workflow, and we expect that role to keep expanding.

We care about building things well, shipping systems that create leverage, and continuously improving how engineering work gets done.

We appreciate people who combine strong engineering judgment with pragmatism, curiosity, and a deep interest in how AI is changing software development itself.

What You’ll Do

Help transform and scale AI-assisted software development practices across the organization:

  • Establish engineering best practices around AI-assisted and agentic coding workflows
  • Drive adoption of modern AI development tooling such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, MCP-enabled workflows, autonomous agents, and related systems
  • Improve development velocity and code quality through AI-assisted review, testing, refactoring, documentation, and automation practices
  • Define and evolve engineering workflows for AI-native software delivery, including PR review standards, coding conventions, development environments, and collaboration patterns
  • Mentor engineers on effective usage of AI coding tools, balancing speed, maintainability, reliability, and engineering judgment
  • Evaluate emerging AI development paradigms and help the organization adopt practical approaches with real leverage
  • Collaborate closely with engineering teams while remaining hands-on enough to understand workflow bottlenecks and opportunities first hand

Help shape internal engineering tooling, automation systems, and developer productivity infrastructure.

What We Offer

  • A high-autonomy role with significant influence on engineering practices and development culture
  • The opportunity to help define how AI-assisted software engineering is adopted at scale inside the organization
  • Modern AI-assisted engineering tools and freedom to experiment with new workflows and technologies
  • A fast-moving, collaborative environment with talented and ambitious people
  • A broad variety of technical and operational challenges across multiple industries and domains
  • Competitive compensation and benefits
  • Flexible working hours and hybrid work setup

You’re Probably a Fit If

  • You have experience leading or mentoring software engineering teams in fast-moving environments
  • You actively use AI coding tools daily — Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, or similar — and have developed strong opinions about where they create leverage and where human judgment still matters most
  • You think deeply about developer productivity, engineering workflows, code review quality, maintainability, and software delivery effectiveness
  • You can balance pragmatism and engineering rigor without becoming process-heavy
  • You are comfortable introducing new workflows and helping teams adopt them effectively
  • You stay current with emerging development paradigms around LLMs, coding agents, autonomous workflows, MCP ecosystems, and AI-native engineering practices
  • You are still technically strong enough to engage credibly with engineers and understand the realities of day-to-day software development
  • You enjoy improving systems, workflows, and organizations — not just writing code


Experience with backend systems, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD systems, developer platforms, LLM applications, agent frameworks, or internal engineering tooling is a strong plus.

You do not need experience with every technology we use. Strong engineering judgment, adaptability, curiosity, and the ability to help teams evolve matter much more.


If this sounds like the right fit for you, we’d love to hear from you.


Interested candidates are invited to apply via the following link:

https://duferco.talentics.ai/job/acf31343-af32-4da9-98d4-b985d14baa10

json.title: PhD Candidate in Agentic AI, Strategy, and Industrial Transformation (m/w/d)
json.descriptionHtml:
Your tasks

Generative and agentic AI are reshaping both products and organizations. They enable entirely new products and services and transform how work is organized and coordinated between humans and intelligent systems. To further expand our growing research team in this area, we are looking for a PhD candidate with the ambition to create meaningful impact. If you are interested in how these technologies reshape industrial companies from a strategic perspective, we are looking for you.

What To Expect

  • Conduct applied research on generative and agentic AI in close collaboration with industry partners, focusing on next-generation products and organizations
  • Co-develop and support the implementation of strategies, business models, products, and processes for generative and agentic AI
  • Contribute to the design and evaluation of generative and agentic AI systems, including prototypes and live systems in real-world organizational contexts
  • Derive rigorous, publishable insights from joint projects with industry partners, ensuring both academic excellence and practical relevance
  • Communicate results through high-impact publications, presentations, and regular interaction with executive (C-level) stakeholders

Your profile

What You Bring

  • Strong interest in agentic AI, technology-driven innovation, entrepreneurship, business models, and strategy
  • Academic background in business and/or technology (e.g., management, economics, information systems, computer science, or engineering)
  • Experience with data analytics, machine learning, natural language processing, generative AI, or AI agents
  • Prior experience in applied research, startups, consulting, or venture capital is a plus
  • Strong conceptual thinking and excellent communication skills, with confidence in presenting research to interdisciplinary audiences
  • Master's degree with a GPA of at least 5.0 (equivalent to 2.0 or better in Germany or Austria), meeting the requirements for PhD admission at the University of St. Gallen
